prayers.original:
You, through the things You have done,
made known the everlasting order of the world.
You, Lord, created the earth.
You are faithful in every generation,
righteous in Your judgments,
wonderful in strength and majesty,
wise in creating
and understanding in establishing what You have made.
You are good in all we can see,
and faithful to those who trust in You.

Merciful and compassionate One,
forgive us our wrongdoing and our injustice,
our sins and our failings.
Do not count against us every sin of Your servants, men and women,
but make us clean with the cleansing of Your truth.

Guide our steps,
so that we walk in holiness, righteousness, and singleness of heart,
and do what is good and pleasing in Your sight
and in the sight of those who govern us.

Yes, Master,
let Your face shine on us in peace, for our good,
so that we may be sheltered by Your mighty hand
and set free from every sin by Your uplifted arm.
And rescue us from those who hate us without cause.

Give harmony and peace to us
and to everyone who lives on the earth,
as You gave them to our fathers
when they called on You in holiness, in faith and truth,
so that we may be saved,
while we obey Your almighty and most excellent name,
and those who rule and lead us here on earth.

Amen.

I made promises to You and to the people I hurt,

This time, give me a change that holds.
Make me ready to do Your will, not just feel bad about mine.
Let me walk a new way, one day at a time,
and make right what is mine to make right.
Amen.

prayers.title: Nerses of Clajes - Prayer for a Willing Heart
prayers.full_text:
Lord, lover of what is good and director of the will:
do not let me follow the inclinations of my heart,
but lead me, so that I may always walk according to Your good pleasure.
Have mercy on Your creatures,
and on me, a grievous sinner.

prayers.title: If They Say No
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I am sorry, and You know I mean it.
But sorry that only sits in me goes sour.
Turn it into love I can act on.
Help me give back what was never mine to keep,
and ask forgiveness of the one I hurt
without demanding that they give it.
If they say no, let me have done my part,
and leave the rest with You.
Amen.

prayers.title: Swallowing My Pride
prayers.full_text:
Lord, my pride would rather be right than be honest.
I can see what I did wrong.
I just do not want to say it out loud.
Give me the humility to own it,
and the backbone to go and fix it.
Let me be the one who looks small, if that is what it takes
for the person I hurt to stand a little taller.
Amen.

prayers.title: Putting It Off
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I know who I need to go see.
I have known for a while.
I keep finding reasons to put it off.
Next week. After payday. When things calm down.
I keep coming to You as if that settles it,
but You said to leave the gift at the altar
and go make it right first.
Do not let me rest easy until I have gone.
Amen.

let me carry my share of making them right.
Make me humble enough to go to the people I hurt,
and give me the rest of my days
to live in love and in the truth.
Amen.

prayers.title: A Clean Apology
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I have wronged You, and I have wronged them.
When I go to them, keep my apology clean.
No "but." No "if I hurt you." No story about why.
Let me say what I did, plainly,
and ask what I can do to set it right.
Then let me listen, even if it is hard to hear.
Amen.

prayers.title: I Will Be No Longer Mine Own
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I am no longer my own;
I give myself to Your will in all things.
I put myself wholly into Your hands.
Let me do what You desire.
Place me with whomever You choose.
Put me to doing, put me to suffering.
Let me be put to work for You, or set aside for You.
Make me willing to be made willing.
Let me humble myself and
make amends to all whom I have wronged,
for Your sake. In Jesus' name I pray.
prayers.original: I will be no longer mine own, but give up myself to thy will in all things. I put myself wholly into thy hands: put me to what thou wilt, rank me with whom thou wilt; put me to doing, put me to suffering; let me be employed for thee, or laid aside for thee. Make me willing to be made willing to humble myself and to make amends to all whom I have wronged, for thy sake.

prayers.title: The Rest of the List
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I have made the amends I know about.
There are more I cannot see yet.
Show me the harm I have not noticed,
the people who carried what I did and never said a word.
When You show me, do not let me argue.
Make me willing, and then make me willing again.
Amen.

prayers.title: A Heart That Can Feel Again
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I know I hurt people.
I can say it. I just cannot feel it yet.
Years of numbing myself turned my heart to stone.
Take out the stone and give me a heart that can feel again,
even if what it feels first is how much I hurt them.
Let that be what moves me to go and make it right.
Amen.

prayers.title: What Each One Needs
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I used to think my sins were between You and me.
They did not stay there. They landed on people You love.
Help me see them the way You see them.
And show me what each one needs from me:
for one, the words; for another, the money back;
for another, a changed life and nothing said at all.
Give me the love to do whichever it is.
Amen.

prayers.title: Check My Reasons
prayers.full_text:
Lord, check my reasons.
I want to make things right,
but part of me wants to look good doing it,
or just to stop feeling bad.
Let my amends be for the people I hurt, not for me.
Let me go even if it earns me nothing,
and if anyone notices the change in me,
let them see You, not me.
Amen.

prayers.full_text: Almighty, everlasting God, give unto us a willing spirit to forgive as we would be forgiven, and to seek forgiveness where we have sinned against our brethren. prayers.full_text: O my God, I am heartily sorry for having offended Thee and injured my neighbour. I firmly purpose amendment. I resolve, by the help of thy grace, to confess my sins, to do penance, to restore what I have unjustly taken, and to seek the forgiveness of those whom I have offended, to the best of my power.

prayers.full_text: O Lord, as I go forth this day, let me remember my duty to amend. Show me the persons I have harmed by sharp word, neglect, or dishonesty. Give me the willingness this day to visit them, to own my fault, and to make such reparation as lies in my power, for thy mercy's sake.

prayers.title: Evening Confession of Wrongs and Willingness to Repair
prayers.full_text: I confess to thee, O God, the wrongs I have done this day to my neighbour. I have been unkind, unjust, untrue. I have not loved as thou hast loved me. I now purpose, with thy help, to repair those wrongs to-morrow, to ask his pardon, and to restore what is his own. Grant me willingness thereunto.

Where I have defrauded, let me restore; where I have lied, let me confess the truth; where I have wounded, let me heal, willingly and promptly, for thy honour.

prayers.full_text: O Father of mercies, whose love is without measure, kindle in us love toward those whom we have wronged. Remove our fear and pride, and make us willing to draw near to them, to ask their pardon, to make amends for our offence, and to live at peace with all men through Jesus Christ.

prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Litany of Willingness to Amend
prayers.full_text: O Lamb of God, that takest away the sins of the world, grant us thy peace. Inspire us to seek thy peace with our brother. Give us willing hearts to confess wherein we have offended him, to make such restitution as we are able, and to walk henceforth in brotherly love and good will.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer of St. Francis Adapted for Amends
prayers.full_text: Lord, make me an instrument of thy peace. Where I have sown hatred, let me sow love; where I have injured, let me now forgive and seek forgiveness. Grant that I may not so much seek to be consoled as to console those I have hurt, to be understood as to make amends to those I have wounded.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8

prayers.title: Quaker Prayer for Willingness to Repair
prayers.full_text: O Thou who revealest our faults in the light of Thy truth, show me wherein I have wronged my fellow. Make me willing to descend from my self-will, to acknowledge the hurt I have caused, and to restore that which will make whole my brother and my own soul.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Methodist Prayer for Readiness to Confess
prayers.full_text: O God, search me and try me. Bring to remembrance my offences against my neighbour. Help me to number them before thee, and then to go with willing heart to those whom I have injured, that I may confess my fault freely and make such amends as thou dost require.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer of the Penitent Publican for Willingness
prayers.full_text: O God, be merciful to me a sinner. I have sinned against thee and before men. I have caused loss and sorrow. I would now, with thy help, be willing to make amends to every soul I have wronged, to restore what is lost, and to seek pardon from all whom I have offended.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Evening Prayer for Willingness on the Morrow
prayers.full_text: Almighty and most merciful Father, I have wandered and strayed from thy ways. I have followed too much the devices of my own heart, and have thereby wronged my brother. Grant, O most merciful Father, that I may be willing on the morrow to seek him, to confess, and to repair my offence.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Grace to Make Satisfaction
prayers.full_text: Most merciful God, who by the blood of thy Son hast forgiven us, teach us to forgive and to seek forgiveness, and to make satisfaction for our wrongs. Where we have harmed our neighbour, grant us not only sorrow but willingness to make restitution, to the uttermost of our power.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Hebraic Prayer for Willingness to Seek Atonement from Man
prayers.full_text: Lord of the world, before I ask atonement from Thee, I must ask it of those I have wronged. Open my lips to confess my sin to my neighbour. Bend my stubborn will, that I may be willing to make amends to him who bears a grievance against me, and to restore to him that which is his.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Humility to Make Amends
prayers.full_text: O God, humble me. Take away my pride which hinders me from confessing my wrong to my brother. Let me count it not shame to say I have done wrong, but honour to repair it. Give me a willingness this day to make amends for all my injuries to others.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Intercession for Those We Have Wronged and Willingness
prayers.full_text: O Lord, I intercede for those whom I have injured. Keep them in thy mercy. And grant that I may not remain content with praying for them, but that I may also be willing to go to them, to ask their forgiveness, and to make such restitution as I am able, in thy name.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Final Prayer of Willingness to Complete Amends
prayers.full_text: Eternal God, who hast made me willing to see my faults, now make me willing to repair them wholly. Let my list of those I have harmed become a list of those to whom I have made amends. Teach me to be prompt, humble, and generous in restitution, that I may live at peace with thee and with all men. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 8
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 8 - Willing Amends".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Readiness to Make Amends
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, give to Thy servant a meek and gentle spirit, that I may be slow to anger, and easy to mercy and forgiveness. Lord, let me ever be courteous, and easy to be entreated; let me never fall into a peevish or contentious spirit, but follow peace with all men; offering forgiveness, inviting them by courtesies, ready to confess my own errors, apt to make amends, and desirous to be reconciled. Make me like unto the holy Jesus.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Jeremy Taylor

prayers.title: For Confession of Sins Past
prayers.full_text: Almighty and merciful God, the Fountain of all Goodness, who knowest the thoughts of our hearts, we confess unto Thee that we have sinned against Thee, and done evil in Thy sight. Wash us, we beseech Thee, from the stains of our past sins, and give us grace and power to put away all hurtful things; so that, being delivered from the bondage of sin, we may bring forth worthy fruits of repentance.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Forgiveness of Youth and Age
prayers.full_text: Forgive me my sins, O Lord, forgive me the sins of my youth and the sins of mine age, the sins of my soul, and the sins of my body, my secret and my whispering sins, my presumptuous and my crying sins, the sins that I have done to please myself, and the sins that I have done to please others. Forgive me those sins which I know, and those sins which I know not; forgive them, O Lord, forgive them all of Thy great goodness.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: To Confess Voluntary and Involuntary Offences
prayers.full_text: Pardon, O God, our offences, done voluntarily or involuntarily, wittingly or unwittingly, by word or deed or in thought; forgive those that are hidden and those that are manifest, those which were done long ago, those which are known, and those which are forgotten, but are known unto Thee. Forgive us, O God, through Jesus Christ our Lord.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Traditional — Eastern Orthodox Liturgy

prayers.title: For Peacemaking and Amendment
prayers.full_text: Thou gracious and gentle and condescending God, Thou God of peace, Father of mercy, God of all comfort; see, I lament before Thee the evil of my heart; I acknowledge that I am too much disposed to anger, jealousy and revenge, to ambition and pride, which often give rise to discord and bitter feelings between me and others. Too often have I thus offended and grieved both Thee, O longsuffering Father, and my fellowmen. Oh, forgive me this sin, and suffer me to partake of the blessing which Thou hast promised to the peacemakers.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Johann Arndt

prayers.title: To Do No Hurt to My Neighbor
prayers.full_text: Heavenly Father, Who watchest always over Thy faithful people, and mightily defendest them, so that they be harmless preserved, I most heartily thank Thee that it hath pleased Thy fatherly goodness to take care of me this night past. I most entirely beseech Thee, O most merciful Father, to show the like kindness toward me this day, in preserving my body and soul; that I may neither think, breathe, speak, or do anything that may be displeasing to Thy fatherly goodness, dangerous to myself, or hurtful to my neighbor.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: To Make Others the Happier
prayers.full_text: Lord, grant that each one who has to do with me today may be the happier for it. Let it be given me each hour today what I shall say, and grant me the wisdom of a loving heart that I may say the right thing rightly. Help me to enter into the mind of every one who talks with me, and keep me alive to the feelings of each one present. Give me quick perception of the feelings and needs of others, and make me eagerhearted in helping them.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: To Bear Responsibility Without Anger
prayers.full_text: O Lord, let me not henceforth desire health or life, except to spend them for Thee, with Thee, and in Thee. Thou alone knowest what is good for me; do, therefore, what seemeth Thee best. Give to me, or take from me; conform my will to Thine; and grant that, with humble and perfect submission, and in holy confidence, I may receive the orders of Thine eternal Providence; and may equally adore all that comes to me from Thee.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Blaise Pascal

prayers.title: For Rectitude in Dealing
prayers.full_text: Grant, Almighty God, that we may this day endeavor to be that which Thou wouldst have us to be, and to do that which Thou commandest, listening to the voice of Thy Spirit within us, not leaving one fault unrepented of, one spot in our hearts uncleansed, and sparing least of all that sin with which it costeth us most to part; loving all men, doing good unto all men, loving Thee, and never doubting that Thou lovest us.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Restoration to Right Paths
prayers.full_text: Rescued from the captivity of the sins which have oppressed us, we may attain the dwellings of the heavenly Jerusalem. Lord, vouchsafe to look mercifully upon us, and grant that we may choose the way of peace; so that we may turn from evil, confess our faults to those we have harmed, and walk henceforth in newness of life.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Bearing Others Burdens Without Harm
prayers.full_text: O God, who art faithful and just to forgive us our sins, mercifully incline our hearts to keep Thy law, and guide our feet into the way of peace; strengthen our wills that they may choose the good, and refuse the evil; help us to bear each other's burdens, to forgive one another's faults, and to forbear with every defect of judgment and of temper in those with whom we live.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Confessing Hidden Faults
prayers.full_text: God, the Shepherd of all Thy people, deliver us from all sins which do assail us, that so we may ever be pleasing in Thy sight, and safe under Thy shelter; search our consciences, and cast out of us every evil thought, every base desire, all envy and pride, all wrath and anger, more especially the remembrance of injuries, and all that is contrary to Thy holy will.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Traditional — Liturgy of St. James

prayers.title: The Collect for Purity - Book of Common Prayer
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, unto whom all hearts are open, all desires known, and from whom no secrets are hid; cleanse the thoughts of our hearts by the inspiration of Thy Holy Spirit, that we may perfectly love Thee, and worthily magnify Thy holy Name; and grant that all my doings may be agreeable to Thy most blessed will, which is alway good; that they may advance Thy glory and profit my neighbor, whom I ought to love as myself.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9

prayers.title: For Reparation Without Injury
prayers.full_text: Lord, give us grace and strength to overcome every sin; sins of besetment, deliberation, negligence, and omission; sins against Thee, our self, our neighbor; sins great, small, remembered, forgotten. Grant us to make restitution where injury was done, and to restore what was taken or wasted, without causing further hurt to any.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]

prayers.title: A Prayer to Be Made Whole
prayers.full_text: Lord, forgive what I have been, sanctify what I am, and order what I shall be. I confess my house of soul is too narrow for Thee; do Thou enlarge it, that Thou mayest enter in; it is ruinous, but do Thou repair it. It has that within which must offend Thine eyes; I confess and know it; but whose help shall I implore but Thine, to heal my past wrongs to others.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9

prayers.title: For Direct Amends
prayers.full_text: O God, who hast taught us to trust in Thee as our loving Father, open our hearts to share that most daring faith which Thou hast revealed to Thy servants in all ages. Grant unto us that we who seek the shelter of Thy protection, being defended from all evils, may serve Thee in peace and quietness of spirit, and be made willing to repay, restore, and reconcile wherever we have caused loss.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For a Quiet Heart, with an amends close
prayers.full_text: Grant unto us, Almighty God, of Thy good Spirit, that quiet heart, and that patient lowliness to which Thy comforting Spirit comes; that we, being humble toward Thee, and loving toward one another, may have our hearts prepared for that peace which passeth understanding; and being made humble, may confess our wrongs and make just amendment.

prayers.title: For Keeping Word to Those Wronged
prayers.full_text: Grant me, I beseech Thee, Almighty and most merciful God, fervently to desire, wisely to search out, and perfectly to fulfil, all that is well-pleasing unto Thee. Order Thou my worldly condition to the glory of Thy Name; and, of all that Thou requirest me to do, grant me the knowledge, the desire, and the ability, that I may so fulfil it as I ought, keeping promises made to those I have injured.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9

prayers.title: To Seek Forgiveness and Restore
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Maker of all things, Judge of all men; we acknowledge and bewail our manifold sins and wickedness, which we, from time to time, most grievously have committed, by thought, word, and deed, against Thy Divine Majesty, provoking most justly Thy wrath and indignation against us. We do earnestly repent, and are heartily sorry for these our misdoings, and purpose to make restitution where we can.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Thomas Cranmer

prayers.title: For Sincere Repentance and Restitution 1
prayers.full_text: O most merciful Father, who hast been pleased to take care of me and to preserve me, I lament the wrongs I have done to others by unkind speech and selfish deed. I confess my offences and desire to amend; grant me courage to go to those I have harmed, to acknowledge my fault plainly, and to offer such reparation as may be just without causing further pain.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: To Make Amends Without Harm 2
prayers.full_text: Heavenly Father, we have loved Thee but not enough, we have sought Thee but not diligently; our hearts have been far from Thee. Draw them now in mercy unto Thyself, that the time to come be not as the past, but that, finding and loving Thee, we may have rest and joy. Teach us to restore what we have taken, to speak truth where we deceived, and to do so with gentleness that injures no one.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Courage to Repair 3
prayers.full_text: Lord, who knowest what is best for us; let this or that be done, as Thou shalt please. Behold, I am Thy servant, prepared for all things; for I desire not to live unto myself, but unto Thee. Grant me grace to face those I have wronged, to confess my part without excuse, and to make such humble restitution as Thy will requires, trusting Thy mercy to keep me from further harm.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9

Kept with disclosure per Paul.] [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Thomas à Kempis

prayers.title: For Loving Reparation 4
prayers.full_text: O God, who art Love, let Thy Divine Spirit flow like a river through our souls, and lead us in the right way. Renew in us the sense of Thy gracious Presence, and let it be a constant impulse to peace and truth. Bestow on me a genial spirit and unwearied forbearance; a mild, loving, patient heart; that I may give offence to none, but as much as in me lies live in charity, confessing faults and making amends wherever justice bids.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Responsibility and No Further Hurt 5
prayers.full_text: O Lord and heavenly Father, grant that no clouds of this mortal life may hide from us the light of that love which is immortal. Grant us Thy light, that we may have life. Help us now to stand awhile in shelter, to understand our trespasses against others, and to seek their pardon without excuse, offering recompense that heals rather than wounds, through Jesus Christ our Lord.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 9
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 9 - Responsibility Do No Harm".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Direct Us in All Our Doings
prayers.full_text: Direct us, O Lord, in all our doings with thy most gracious favour, and further us with thy continual help; that in all our works begun, continued, and ended in thee, we may glorify thy holy Name, and finally, by thy mercy, obtain everlasting life; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Thomas Aquinas - To Know Thee
prayers.full_text: Grant me, O Lord my God, a mind to know you, a heart to seek you, wisdom to find you, conduct pleasing to you, faithful perseverance in waiting for you, and a hope of finally embracing you. Grant that I may be penitent for my evil ways, may make use of thy gifts, and may persevere in thy grace. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Thomas Aquinas

prayers.title: Thomas à Kempis - Thy Will Be Mine
prayers.full_text: Grant me, O most gracious Jesus, to rest in thee above every creature, above all health and beauty, above all glory and honor, above all power and dignity, above all knowledge and subtlety, above all riches and arts, above all joy and exultation, above all fame and praise, above all sweetness and consolation, above all hope and promise, above all desert and desire, above all gifts and presents, above all mirth and jollity. Let thy will be mine, and let my will always follow thine. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Thomas à Kempis

prayers.title: Augustine - Let Me Know Thee
prayers.full_text: O Lord, who art ever the same, let me know myself, let me know thee. Let me know myself that I may be humbled, let me know thee that I may love thee. In thee I have placed all my hope, for thou wilt heal all my infirmities. Show me thy will and give me power to do it. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: St. Augustine

prayers.title: Suscipe - Ignatius Loyola
prayers.full_text: Take, O Lord, and receive all my liberty, my memory, my understanding, and my entire will, all that I have and possess. Thou hast given all to me. To thee, O Lord, I return it. All is thine, dispose of it wholly according to thy will. Give me thy love and thy grace, for this is sufficient for me. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Ignatius Loyola

prayers.title: Jeremy Taylor - For Resignation
prayers.full_text: O Almighty God, who art the guide of them that humbly seek thee, direct my ways and establish my thoughts, that whatsoever I do, I may do it to thy glory, and whatsoever I suffer, I may suffer it patiently, resigning myself and all my fortune to thy divine pleasure and providence; through Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Jeremy Taylor

prayers.title: Andrew Murray - Thy Will Be Done in Me
prayers.full_text: Father, Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Let Thy will be done in me as willingly, as cheerfully, as perfectly as it is done in heaven. I surrender myself unreservedly to it, to be taught, and led, and governed by it. Make known to me Thy will, and give me grace to do it. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Andrew Murray

prayers.title: Fenelon - Abandonment to Divine Will
prayers.full_text: O Lord, I know not what I ought to ask of thee; thou alone knowest what I need. Thou lovest me better than I know how to love myself. Grant to me, thy child, what is most needful, yet I dare not ask it lest I ask amiss. I only pray, Lord, do with me according to thy will, and let thy will be done in me. Amen.

prayers.title: Daily Strength - Morning Surrender
prayers.full_text: O my God, give me light to see the duties of this day, grace to fulfil them, and perseverance to continue in well-doing to the end thereof. Show me thy will and teach me to perform it. Let no self-will blind me, nor sloth possess me, nor fear hinder me; but grant that in all things I may seek thy glory first. Amen.

prayers.title: Daily Strength - To Be Led
prayers.full_text: Lead me, O Lord, in the path that thou hast chosen for me. Suffer me not to choose my own way, but let thy wisdom guide me, thy power guard me, and thy love fill me. The path may not be smooth nor easy, but if it be thy will, it will surely lead to thee at last. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]

prayers.title: Thomas à Kempis - Teach Me Thy Will
prayers.full_text: Lord, thou knowest what is best for me. Do with me therefore as it pleaseth thee. Give what thou wilt, and how much thou wilt, and when thou wilt. Do with me as thou knowest, and as best shall please thee, and shall be most to thy honour. Set me where thou wilt, and freely do with me in all things according to thy will. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11

prayers.title: Prayer for Divine Guidance - 1900 Manual
prayers.full_text: Almighty and everlasting God, who art the light of the faithful and the shepherd of souls, send forth thy light into our hearts, that we may see what we ought to do, and give us power to do it. Let thy holy will guide every thought, word, and deed, that we may not wander from the way of thy commandments. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11

prayers.title: The Collect for Peace, with a step-eleven close - Book of Common Prayer
prayers.full_text: O God, from whom all holy desires, all good counsels, and all just works do proceed; Give unto thy servants that peace which the world cannot give; that both our hearts may be set to obey thy commandments, and that we may faithfully seek to do thy will in all things; through Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Newman - Lead Kindly Light Prayer
prayers.full_text: Lead, kindly Light, amid the encircling gloom, lead thou me on! The night is dark, and I am far from home; lead thou me on! Keep thou my feet; I do not ask to see the distant scene; one step enough for me. Lead me, O Lord, according to thy will, till thy will be perfectly done in me. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Conscious Contact
prayers.full_text: O Holy Spirit of God, who abidest in the souls of those who love thee, teach me to seek thee in silence, to find thee in prayer, and to keep conscious communion with thee throughout the day. Let me not forget thy presence, but make me ever aware of thy guiding hand. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Meditation
prayers.full_text: Grant, O Lord, that as we now meditate upon thy word and seek thy face, our hearts may be opened to hear thy voice, our minds illumined to understand thy truth, and our wills strengthened to obey thy commandments. Speak, Lord, for thy servants hear. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11

prayers.title: Prayer for Morning Guidance
prayers.full_text: O eternal God, who hast made this day and willed that we should live in it; grant that we may spend it in remembrance of thee. Guide our thoughts, our words, and our deeds, that whatsoever we do, we may do it to fulfil thy holy will; through Jesus Christ. Amen.

prayers.title: The Soul Thou Gavest Me Is Pure
prayers.full_text: My God, the soul which thou hast given me is pure; thou didst create it, thou didst form it, thou didst breathe it into me. Thou preservest it within me. Grant that I may this day know thy will, and walk in thy good way, and keep thy holy law before me continually. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Illumination
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, who hast given us thy holy word to be a lantern unto our feet and a light unto our path; Grant that we may so read, mark, and inwardly digest it, that through patience and comfort of thy holy word, we may know and do thy will; through Jesus Christ. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Meditation Hour
prayers.full_text: O Lord Jesus Christ, who art the way, the truth, and the life, grant that in this hour of meditation we may not be distracted by worldly cares, but may listen to thy still small voice within. Show us thy will and make us strong to follow it, even unto the cross. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]

prayers.title: Prayer for Divine Light
prayers.full_text: O Lord, who art the everlasting Light, illumine my darkness. O thou who art infinite Love, cast out my fear. O thou who art true Wisdom, instruct my ignorance. Let me know thee according to thy will, love thee according to thy grace, and serve thee according to thy good pleasure. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer to Seek God's Will
prayers.full_text: Teach me, O Lord, to seek thee, and reveal thyself to me as I seek. For I cannot seek thee except thou teach me, nor find thee except thou reveal thyself. Let me seek thee in longing, and long for thee in seeking. Let me find thee in love, and love thee in finding. Thy will be done in me. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Daily Duty
prayers.full_text: O Lord our God, grant us grace to desire thee with our whole heart, that so desiring, we may seek and find thee; and so finding thee, may love thee; and loving thee, may hate those sins from which thou hast redeemed us, and may daily do thy will more fully. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Guidance in Doubt
prayers.full_text: O Lord, in whose hands are life and death, whose power alone can make our path plain; when our way seemeth dark and we cannot see our course, guide us still by thy counsel, and afterward receive us to glory, that we may know thy will is best. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Will of God - Murray
prayers.full_text: O my Father, I submit myself to thee. Let thy will be my will. Let my will be swallowed up in thine. What thou hast chosen for me, that will I choose. What thou hast appointed for me, let that be my portion. Teach me to pray and live, Thy will be done. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Conscious Union
prayers.full_text: O God, who makest us to dwell in one mind and heart with thee; grant that we may so abide in thee and thou in us, that our thoughts may be thy thoughts, our desires thy desires, and our will ever one with thine; through Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer Before Meditation
prayers.full_text: Prevent us, O Lord, in all our doings with thy most gracious favour, and further us with thy continual help, that in all our works begun, continued, and ended in thee, we may glorify thy holy name, and may with thee in conscious fellowship walk all our days. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Evening Reflection Prayer
prayers.full_text: O Lord, who at evening didst pray in the garden; teach us to pray even as thou didst, saying not my will, but thine be done. In the silence of this hour, make known unto us thy purpose, and give us humble hearts to receive it. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Spiritual Understanding
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, fountain of all wisdom, who knowest our necessities before we ask, and our ignorance in asking: We beseech thee to have compassion upon our infirmities, and give us wisdom from above, that we may discern thy will and walk in thy ways all our days. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Brother Lawrence - Presence Prayer
prayers.full_text: O my God, since thou art with me, and I must now, in obedience to thy commands, apply my mind to outward things, I beseech thee to grant me the grace to continue in thy presence; and to this end do thou prosper me with thy assistance, that I may know thy will in all. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]

prayers.title: Prayer for Right Judgment
prayers.full_text: Grant, O Lord, that we may not lean upon our own understanding, but in all our ways acknowledge thee, that thou mayest direct our paths. Save us from hasty judgment and self-will, and teach us to wait upon thee, to know thy mind and to do thy will. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Acceptance
prayers.full_text: O Lord, I would delight in thy will, though I cannot understand thy ways. I would trust thy wisdom though it contradict my hopes. I would submit to thy disposal though it cross my desires. Let thy gracious will be the rule and quiet of my soul. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Tersteegen - Thy Will Alone
prayers.full_text: Thy will alone, O God, be done in me and by me and around me. May nothing happen in my life to-day but what is well-pleasing to thee, and may I desire nothing but to be wholly conformed to thy holy will in all things. Amen.

prayers.title: A Kempis - Will United
prayers.full_text: O Lord God, let my soul be ever united to thee, let my heart and my whole will be knit unto thee alone. Grant that I may will what thou willest, that I may be one spirit with thee, and that in all things my will may be lost in thine. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]

prayers.title: Boehme - Inner Light
prayers.full_text: O Lord, open my inward eye to see thy will within me, and my inward ear to hear thy voice. Let thy spirit guide me into all truth, and make my soul a house of prayer, where I may continually commune with thee and know thy presence. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]

prayers.title: Prayer for Morning Meditation
prayers.full_text: Into thy hand, O God, I commend this day and all that is in it. I consecrate all my thoughts, words, and deeds to thee. Guide and govern me by thy holy will. I desire nothing but what thou desirest for me. Thy will be done in me this day. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Prayer for Seeking and Finding
prayers.full_text: O God, thou hast made us for thyself, and our hearts are restless till they find rest in thee. Show me, O Lord, what thou wouldest have me to do, and grant that seeking I may find, and finding may love, and loving may serve thee faithfully forever. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Pusey - Knowledge of Will
prayers.full_text: Lord Jesus, thou who wast ever about thy Father's business, teach me to seek first thy kingdom, and to let all things else be ordered according to thy will. Illuminate my understanding, purify my affection, and conform my will to thine. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]

prayers.title: Prayer for Stillness
prayers.full_text: Be still, O my soul, and know that he is God. Cease from thine own wisdom, thine own planning, thine own willing, and rest in his will. Let me hear thy still small voice, O Lord, and obey it, that I may dwell in thy peace. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Litany of the Will of God
prayers.full_text: From all attachment to created things, O Lord, deliver me. From all inordinate affection and self-will, O Lord, deliver me. From desiring that which is not thy will, save me. Make me willing to be what thou wilt have me to be, and to do what thou wilt have me do. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: Hilton - Prayer of Quiet
prayers.full_text: Lord, as I sit in quietness before thee, set my heart at liberty from all things that would hinder the knowledge of thy will. Let me not run to and fro with restless thoughts, but let thy will be the anchor of my soul and thy presence my rest. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: Walter Hilton

prayers.title: Francis de Sales - Do Thy Will Cheerfully
prayers.full_text: My God, grant that I may do thy will cheerfully and with a loving heart, without repining or complaining. What thou willest, I will; where thou willest, there will I go; what thou willest me to suffer, that will I bear patiently, for thy love's sake. Thy will be done in me and through me. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 11
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 11 - Knowledge Gods Will".]
prayers.author: St. Francis de Sales

prayers.title: For Usefulness
prayers.full_text: Father in heaven, help me at all times to rule myself so that, controlled and clean, I may give myself unto Thee; teach me to look upon Thee alone, and not my friends, as my judge in all things, so that I may not blindly follow the multitude. Give unto me, I beseech Thee, the strength that cannot by word nor thought harm the weak, and the power to be a comfort and a joy to others. Teach me freely to forgive all evil done, and to give unto all men a gentle love. May I find my delight in simple things and may my joys and laughter be free from all bitterness, either of thought or intention. Thus, O Lord, may I prepare myself to sacrifice my life in Thy service.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 12
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: A Prayer for Devotion to Service
prayers.full_text: Give unto us, O Lord, we humbly beseech Thee, a wise, a sober, a patient, an understanding, a devout, a religious, a courageous heart; a soul full of devotion to do Thee service, strength against all temptations; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 12
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: To Live Not for Self
prayers.full_text: Warm my cold heart, Lord. Form me after Thine own image. Give me grace to obey Thee in all things and to always follow where Thou leadest. Teach me to be kind to others, to be gentle and unselfish, careful to hurt no one by word or deed, but eager to do good to all and to make others happy. I do not want to live for myself, but for Thee. Keep me today, Lord, from all sin, and from anything that displeases Thee; for Jesus Christ's sake. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 12
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: To Spend Our Lives in Thy Service
prayers.full_text: Eternal God, who makest all things new, and abidest for ever the same, grant us to commence this year in Thy faith, and to continue it in Thy favor, that, being guided in all our doings, and guarded all our days, we may spend our lives in Thy service, and finally, by Thy grace, attain the glory of everlasting life; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 12
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Missions - That We May Carry Thy Message
prayers.full_text: O God, who hast made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on the face of the whole earth, and didst send thy blessed Son to preach peace to them that are far off and to them that are nigh: Grant that all men everywhere may seek after thee and find thee. Bring the nations into thy fold, pour out thy Spirit upon all flesh, and hasten thy kingdom; through thy Son Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 12
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Usefulness in Daily Work
prayers.full_text: O Lord, our heavenly Father, by whose almighty power we have been created, and by whose goodness we have been preserved to this day; We beseech Thee to direct and bless all our work and service, that we may faithfully serve Thee in our daily calling, and may do all things for the benefit of others, to Thy honor and glory; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.collection: Historic Prayers for Step 12
prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]
prayers.author: Unknown

prayers.title: For Grace to Serve Thee
prayers.full_text: Almighty and everlasting God, who hatest nothing that thou hast made, and dost forgive the sins of all those who are penitent: Create and make in us new and contrite hearts, that we, worthily lamenting our sins and acknowledging our wretchedness, may obtain of thee, the God of all mercy, perfect remission and forgiveness; and may so serve thee with faithful hearts that our lives may show forth thy praise; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: For Help to Help Others
prayers.full_text: O God, the Father of all, whose Son commanded us to love our enemies: Lead them and us from prejudice to truth; deliver them and us from hatred, cruelty, and revenge; and in thy good time enable us all to stand reconciled before thee, to carry thy love to all men; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: That We May Be Useful
prayers.full_text: O merciful God, who hast made us instruments of thy providence: Grant us grace to be faithful stewards of thy bounty; to share with those in need the gifts which thou hast given us; to be diligent in our callings and useful in our generation; and to serve thee in all honest labor; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]

prayers.title: Prayer for Service and Strength
prayers.full_text: Make bare thy mighty arm, O God, and lead this people on. Give us strength to serve, that we may not falter in the hour of trial. Grant us courage to bear the burdens of others, and to carry thy light into darkness; that serving thee in our fellow men, we may fulfill thy purpose. Amen.

prayers.note: [2026-10-14, reader-facing shelf names (Paul): collection was "12 Steps Historic - Step 12 - Service Usefulness".]

prayers.title: For Fidelity in Service
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, whose loving hand hath given us all that we have and all that we are: Grant that we may not be idle or unprofitable servants, but may improve the talents thou hast given us, to the benefit of others and to thy glory; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.full_text: O Lord Jesus Christ, who didst command thy disciples to go into all the world and preach the gospel: Grant us boldness to speak thy truth, humility to live it, and love to carry thy message to those who have not heard; that all men may know thy saving grace. Amen.

prayers.full_text: O God, who hast called us not to be ministered unto, but to minister: Grant us willing hands and faithful hearts, that we may serve thee in serving our fellow men; and may count it our highest privilege to work for thee; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: For Usefulness and Humility
prayers.full_text: Lord, let me not be a cumberer of the ground, but useful in some way to thy creation. Make me humble, patient, and pure; give me work to do for thee, and strength to do it; that I may serve thee faithfully all my days, and at last enter into thy joy. Amen.

prayers.title: That We May Bear One Another's Burdens
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, who hast taught us that no man liveth to himself: Grant that we may bear one another's burdens, that we may comfort the sorrowing, strengthen the weak, and help all who need our aid; that in serving others we may serve thee; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: For Dedication to Service
prayers.full_text: O Eternal God, who hast shown us in thy Son that whoso would be great must be servant of all: Give us willing hearts to follow in his way; to take the lowest place, to do the humblest work, and to serve thee in our brethren for his sake, who came not to be ministered unto but to minister. prayers.full_text: Heavenly Father, let thy blessing be on us as we pass through this day. Amen.

prayers.title: For Opportunity to Serve
prayers.full_text: O God, who knowest our needs before we ask, and our ignorance in asking: Show us where we may be useful; open our eyes to see the needs about us; open our hands to give help; and open our hearts to love all men for the sake of thy Son. Amen.

Amen.

Then, Lord, in thy mercy grant us a safe lodging, and a holy rest, and peace at the last; that having served thee faithfully, we may rest in thee. Amen.

prayers.full_text: O God, who art the author of peace and lover of concord: Defend us, thy humble servants, in all assaults of our enemies; that we, surely trusting in thy defence, may not fear the power of any adversaries; and may serve thee willingly and obediently all our days; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.note: A Kentucky Bootleggers Original -- Paul's own, assembled by him from standard Catholic liturgical components. AUTHORSHIP WORKED THROUGH 2026-08-29, and the first answer was wrong. An AI told him this matched an existing prayer; a search found a close cousin in the 'Prayer Against Oppression' circulated by Exodus 90 and cited to Fr Chad Ripperger's 'Deliverance Prayers: For Use by the Laity' p.43, and I concluded his was a condensed derivative of it. PAUL WAS RIGHT AND I WAS WRONG: I had treated one sentence as a single borrowed unit instead of decomposing it. The intercession clause -- Blessed Mary ever Virgin, the Archangel Michael, the Apostles Peter and Paul -- is THE CONFITEOR, codified in the Roman Missal of Pius V, 1570, and said at every Tridentine Mass. It reached Paul from the liturgy, not from a 2016 book. 'By the power of the precious blood' and 'the Holy Name of Jesus' are likewise standard devotional formulas, and the command form descends from the Rituale Romanum. 'Go to the foot of the cross' is in ubiquitous use, mostly of people going there to repent or pray. That left one phrase whose lineage no search could establish in either direction -- 'to receive Your sentence'. Paul changed it to 'to receive Your judgment', which he preferred on the ear anyway, so nothing in this prayer now shares wording with anything in print. It is his arrangement of public-domain liturgical material and it is his. 2026-08-29, LATER: he restored JOHN THE BAPTIST to the intercession list, making it the full Confiteor of 1570 rather than a shortened one. This cuts both ways in his favour -- the Ripperger-cited list has no John the Baptist, so the prayer now sits closer to the 1570 liturgy and further from anything modern. His reason was not legal: 'John the Baptist was a strong man of God... he was the Elijah of his time... his prayers are very powerful.' He prays this one constantly. LICENCE: shipped CC BY-SA 4.0 like the rest of KSG's content. Naming him as author is what lets a downstream user comply with the attribution term -- it is how the prayer is given away, not how it is fenced off. THIS RECORD STAYS. Paul, 2026-08-29: 'It needs to stay in. It's the most powerful prayer I know of for spiritual warfare.' He prays it constantly. Do not pull it, do not shorten it, do not 'improve' it. USCCB/ICEL QUESTION, RAISED BY HIM AND CLOSED: he wondered whether the intercession list encroaches on USCCB copyright. It does not. ICEL/USCCB hold the 2011 English translation of the Roman Missal -- not the Latin and not older English renderings. Three reasons: the 2011 Confiteor DROPS Michael, John the Baptist and Peter and Paul entirely ('blessed Mary ever-Virgin, all the Angels and Saints'), so naming them is evidence of the OLDER form; his wording is the Tridentine English found in hand missals with imprimaturs from the 1800s-1950s, public domain by age; and copyright protects a translation, not the 1570 Latin behind it. 'And all the saints' is in both forms and would also be safe; 'hosts of heaven' is not Confiteor language at all but echoes Leo XIII's 1886 'Prince of the heavenly host', likewise public domain. prayers.title: St. Patrick's Breastplate
prayers.full_text: Today I rise through Your mighty strength, Lord. I invoke the Trinity, firm in the belief of their three beings, and with confession of Your Oneness, Creator of creation. Today I rise through the strength of Christ's birth with his baptism, through the strength of his crucifixion with his burial, through the strength of his resurrection with his ascension, through the strength of his descent for the judgment of doom. Today I rise through the strength of the love of cherubim, in the obedience of angels, in the service of archangels, in the hope of resurrection to meet with reward, in the prayers of patriarchs, in the predictions of prophets, in the preaching of apostles, in the faith of confessors, in the innocence of holy virgins, in the deeds of righteous men. Today I rise, through the strength of heaven, the light of the sun, the radiance of the moon, the splendor of fire, the speed of lightning, the swiftness of wind, the depth of the sea, the stability of the earth, the firmness of rock. Today I rise, through God's strength to pilot me, God's might to uphold me, God's wisdom to guide me, God's eye to look before me, God's ear to hear me, God's word to speak for me, God's hand to guard me, God's shield to protect me, God's host to save me from snares of devils and temptations of vices, from everyone who shall wish me ill, afar and near, alone and in multitude. I summon today all these powers between me and those evils, against every cruel and merciless power that may oppose my body and soul, against incantations of false prophets, against black laws of pagandom, against false laws of heretics, against craft of idolatry, against spells of witches and smiths and wizards, against every knowledge that corrupts man's body and soul. Christ to shield me today against poison, against burning, against drowning, against wounding, so that an abundant reward may come to me. Christ with me, Christ before me, Christ behind me, Christ in me, Christ beneath me, Christ above me, Christ on my right, Christ on my left, Christ when I lie down, Christ when I sit down, Christ when I arise, Christ in the heart of every man who thinks of me, Christ in the mouth of everyone who speaks of me, Christ in every eye that sees me, Christ in every ear that hears me. Today I rise through Your mighty strength, Lord. I invoke the Trinity, firm in the belief of their three beings, and with confession of Your Oneness, Creator of creation. Amen.

prayers.original:
I bind unto myself today
The strong name of the Trinity,
By invocation of the same
The Three in One and One in Three.

I bind this today to me forever
By power of faith, Christ’s incarnation;
His baptism in Jordan river,
His death on cross for my salvation;
His bursting from the spicèd tomb,
His riding up the heavenly way,
His coming at the day of doom
I bind unto myself today.

I bind unto myself the power
Of the great love of cherubim;
The sweet Well done in judgment hour,
The service of the seraphim,
Confessors’ faith, apostles’ word,
The patriarchs’ prayers, the prophets’ scrolls,
All good deeds done unto the Lord
And purity of virgin souls.

I bind unto myself today
The virtues of the star lit heaven,
The glorious sun’s life giving ray,
The whiteness of the moon at even,
The flashing of the lightning free,
The whirling wind’s tempestuous shocks,
The stable earth, the deep salt sea
Around the old eternal rocks.

I bind unto myself today
The power of God to hold and lead,
His eye to watch, His might to stay,
His ear to hearken to my need.
The wisdom of my God to teach,
His hand to guide, His shield to ward;
The Word of God to give me speech,
His heavenly host to be my guard.

Against the demon snares of sin,
The vice that gives temptation force,
The natural lusts that war within,
The hostile men that mar my course;
Or few or many, far or nigh,
In every place and in all hours,
Against their fierce hostility
I bind to me these holy powers.

Against all Satan’s spells and wiles,
Against false words of heresy,
Against the knowledge that defiles,
Against the heart’s idolatry,
Against the wizard’s evil craft,
Against the death wound and the burning,
The choking wave, the poisoned shaft,
Protect me, Christ, till Thy returning.

Christ be with me, Christ within me,
Christ behind me, Christ before me,
Christ beside me, Christ to win me,
Christ to comfort and restore me.
Christ beneath me, Christ above me,
Christ in quiet, Christ in danger,
Christ in hearts of all that love me,
Christ in mouth of friend and stranger.

I bind unto myself the name,
The strong name of the Trinity,
By invocation of the same,
The Three in One and One in Three.
By whom all nature hath creation,
Eternal Father, Spirit, Word:
Praise to the Lord of my salvation,
Salvation is of Christ the Lord.

prayers.title: Prayer for Guidance and Discernment
prayers.full_text: God, You guide the meek in judgment, and bring light into darkness for the devout! In all my doubts and uncertainties, grant me the grace to ask You what You would have me do. Let Your wisdom save me from all my false choices, that in Your light I might see light. That in Your straight path I might not stumble. I pray this through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.modern: God, You guide the meek in judgment, and bring light into darkness for the devout! In all my doubts and uncertainties, grant me the grace to ask You what You would have me do. Let Your wisdom save me from all my false choices, that in Your light I might see light. That in Your straight path I might not stumble. I pray this through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.original: O God, by whom the meek are guided in judgment, and light riseth up in darkness for the godly: Grant us, in all our doubts and uncertainties, the grace to ask what thou wouldest have us to do, that the Spirit of wisdom may save us from all false choices, and that in thy light we may see light, and in thy straight path may not stumble; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer to the Holy Spirit for Guidance
prayers.full_text: Holy Spirit of God, make me Your disciple; guide, illuminate, and sanctify me. Bind my hands so I can do no evil; cover my eyes so I see it no more; sanctify my heart so evil cannot dwell within me. Be my God and guide. Wherever You lead me, I will go. Whatever You forbid, I will renounce. In Your strength whatever You command, I will do. Lead me to the fullness of Your truth. Amen.
prayers.modern: Holy Spirit of God, make me Your disciple; guide, illuminate, and sanctify me. Bind my hands so I can do no evil; cover my eyes so I see it no more; sanctify my heart so evil cannot dwell within me. Be my God and guide. Wherever You lead me, I will go. Whatever You forbid, I will renounce. In Your strength whatever You command, I will do. Lead me to the fullness of Your truth. Amen.
prayers.original: O Holy Spirit of God, take me as Your disciple; guide me, illuminate me, sanctify me. Bind my hands that they may do no evil; cover my eyes that they may see it no more; sanctify my heart that evil may not dwell within me. Be my God; be my guide. Wherever You lead me, I will go: whatever You forbid me, I will renounce; and whatever You command me, in Your strength, I will do. Lead me, then, unto the fullness of Your truth. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer for Guidance and Help
prayers.full_text: Dear Lord, I am calling on You today for Your holy guidance and help. I am panicking. I need Your support to keep me on the right path. I am deeply troubled. I will strive to keep my heart set on You still. In Your infinite wisdom, You will show me the just and right resolution. Thank You for hearing my prayer and for staying by my side. Amen.
prayers.modern: Dear Lord, I am calling on You today for Your holy guidance and help. I am panicking. I need Your support to keep me on the right path. I am deeply troubled. I will strive to keep my heart set on You still. In Your infinite wisdom, You will show me the just and right resolution. Thank You for hearing my prayer and for staying by my side. Amen.
prayers.original: Dear Lord, I am calling upon You today for Your divine guidance and help. I am in crisis and need a supporting hand to keep me on the right and just path. My heart is troubled but I will strive to keep it set on You, as Your infinite wisdom will show me the right way to a just and right resolution. Thank You for hearing my prayer and for staying by my side. Amen.

prayers.title: The Student’s Prayer (short form)
prayers.full_text: Infinite, Indescribable Creator, true source of wisdom and light, pour Your brilliance upon my intellect. Give me a penetrating mind to understand, a retentive memory, and method and ease in learning. Guide my work, direct its progress, and bring it to successful completion. This I ask through Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: The Suscipe (Receive)
prayers.full_text: Take everything from me Lord! Freely receive all my liberty, memory, understanding, and my entire will. All I have and call my own, You have given everything to me. I return it all back to You Lord. Everything is Yours. Do with it what You will. Give me only Your love and grace. That is enough for me. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer Toward the Unknown
prayers.full_text: Lord, You steadied the hand of Peter as he began to sink on the stormy sea. If You are with me, no one can be against me. Grant me a shield of faith and the mighty armor of the Holy Spirit to protect me. Guide me to do Your will. Lord, I put the future into Your hands. I will follow You to a life in Christ. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer to Your Guardian Angel
prayers.full_text: Angel of Christ, holy guardian, you protect my soul and body. Forgive me of everything I have done daily to offend you. Protect me from all the temptation and influence of the evil one. Never let me offend our God by my sin. Pray for me to the Lord, with the Most Blessed Virgin Mary, and all the Saints, that Christ may make me worthy of the grace of the All-holy Trinity. Amen.

prayers.original: O Angel of Christ, holy guardian and protector of my soul and body, forgive me of everything I have done to offend You every day, and protect me from all influence and temptation of the evil one. May I never offend God by my sin. Pray for me to the Lord, that He may make me worthy of the grace of the All-holy Trinity, and of the Most Blessed Theotokos, and of all the Saints. Amen.

prayers.title: The Jesus Prayer & The Philokalia Petition
prayers.full_text: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner. Enlighten my darkness and guide me in Your commandments. Direct my heart to do Your will. Grant me the Holy Spirit’s grace to discern what is right in Your eyes. You are the light and salvation of my soul forever. Amen.

prayers.original: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner. Enlighten my darkness and guide me in the way of Thy commandments. prayers.title: The Serenity Prayer (Long Form)
prayers.full_text:
God, grant me the serenity
to accept the things I cannot change,
the courage to change the things I can,
and the wisdom to know the difference.

Living one day at a time,
enjoying one moment at a time;
accepting hardship as a pathway to peace;
taking, as Jesus did,
this sinful world as it is,
not as I would have it;
trusting that You will make all things right
if I surrender to Your will;
so that I may be reasonably happy in this life
and supremely happy with You forever in the next.
Amen.

prayers.title: The Complete Student’s Prayer (by St. Thomas Aquinas)
prayers.full_text: Divine and Infinite Creator, who in Your wisdom created three hierarchies of angels and placed them in wonderful order above the heavens. You have wisely placed our world. You are the true fountain of light and wisdom and the highest beginning. Lord, Please pour a double beam of Your brilliance upon the darkness of mind and soul I was born into. Remove all sin and ignorance from me. Lord, You make the words of infants wise and beautiful! Instruct me and pour upon my lips, Your grace and blessing. I beg You to give me a strong memory and a crisp mind to understand. Give me ease in learning using methods You teach. Let me interpret with subtlety and grant me abundant grace when speaking. Teach me, guide me, and perfect me in You who are true God and true Man, who lives and reigns forever, world without end. Amen.

Teach me, guide me, and perfect me in You who are true God and true Man, who lives and reigns forever, world without end. Amen.
prayers.original: O Ineffable Creator, Who, out of the treasure of Thy wisdom, hast ordained three hierarchies of Angels, and placed them in wonderful order above the heavens, and hast most wisely distributed the parts of the world; Thou, Who art called the true fountain of light and wisdom, and the highest beginning, vouchsafe to pour upon the darkness of my understanding, in which I was born, the double beam of Thy brightness, removing from me all darkness of sin and ignorance. Thou, Who makest eloquent the tongues of infants, instruct my tongue, and pour upon my lips the grace of Thy blessing. Grant me, I beseech Thee, a penetrating mind to understand, a retentive memory to retain, a method and facility in learning, subtlety in interpreting, and copious grace in speaking. Instruct me in the beginning, direct me in the progress, and perfect me in the conclusion. Thou, Who art true God and true Man, Who livest and reignest world without end. Amen.

prayers.title: Pope Leo XIII's Prayer to St. Michael the Archangel
prayers.full_text:
O Glorious Prince of the heavenly host, St. Michael the Archangel, defend us in the battle and in the terrible warfare that we are waging against the principalities and powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the evil spirits. Come to the aid of man, whom Almighty God created immortal, made in His own image and likeness, and redeemed at a great price from the tyranny of Satan.

Fight this day the battle of the Lord, together with the holy angels, as already thou hast fought the leader of the proud angels, Lucifer, and his apostate host, who were powerless to resist thee, nor was there place for them any longer in Heaven.

That ancient serpent, who is called the devil and Satan, who seduces the whole world, was cast into the abyss with his angels. Behold, this primeval enemy and murderer of man has become defiant. Transformed into an angel of light, he wanders about with the entire troop of evil spirits in order to blot out the name of God and of His Christ, to seize, to slay and to cast into eternal damnation the souls destined for the crown of eternal glory.

This wicked dragon pours out, as a most impure flood, the venom of his malice on men of depraved mind and corrupt heart, the spirit of lying, of impiety, of blasphemy, and the pestilent breath of impurity, and of every vice and iniquity.

These most crafty enemies have filled and inebriated with gall and bitterness the Church, the Spouse of the Immaculate Lamb, and have laid impious hands on her most sacred possessions. In the Holy Place itself, where the See of Saint Peter and the Chair of Truth has been set up as the light of the world, they have raised the throne of their abominable impiety, with the iniquitous design that when the Pastor has been struck, the sheep may be scattered.

Arise then, O invincible Prince, bring help against the attacks of the lost spirits to the people of God, and give them the victory. Thou who art venerable to the Church of God, the Church which venerates thee as her guardian and protector; to thee the Lord has entrusted the souls of the redeemed to be led into heaven.

Pray the God of peace to crush Satan under our feet, that he may no longer retain men captive and do injury to the Church. Offer our prayers in the sight of the Most High, so that the mercies of the Lord may quickly overtake us and that thou mayest seize the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the devil and Satan, and cast him bound into the abyss, so that he may no longer seduce the nations. Amen.
prayers.short_text: Saint Michael the Archangel, defend us in battle. Be our protection against the wickedness and snares of the devil. May God rebuke him, we humbly pray; and do thou, O Prince of the heavenly host, by the power of God, cast into hell Satan and all the evil spirits who prowl about the world seeking the ruin of souls. Amen.

prayers.title: Adoro Te Devote - O Godhead Hid
prayers.full_text:
O Godhead hid, devoutly I adore Thee,
Who truly art within the forms before me;
To Thee my heart I bow with bended knee,
As failing quite in contemplating Thee.

Sight, touch, and taste in Thee are each deceived;
The ear alone most safely is believed:
I believe all the Son of God has spoken,
Than Truth’s own word there is no truer token.

God only on the Cross lay hid from view;
But here lies hid at once the Manhood too:
And I, in both professing my belief,
Make the same prayer as the repentant thief.

Thy wounds, as Thomas saw, I do not see;
Yet Thee confess my Lord and God to be:
Make me believe Thee ever more and more,
In Thee my hope, in Thee my love to store.

O Memorial of my Saviour dying,
Living Bread, to mortals life supplying,
Make Thou my soul henceforth on Thee to live;
Ever a taste of heavenly sweetness give.

O loving Pelican! O Jesu, Lord!
Unclean I am, but cleanse me in Thy Blood;
Of which a single drop, for sinners spilt,
Can purge the entire world from all its guilt.

Jesu! Whom for the present veiled I see,
What I so thirst for, oh, vouchsafe to me:
That I may see Thy countenance unfolding,
And may be blest Thy glory in beholding.

prayers.full_text:
Godhead here in hiding, whom I do adore,
Masked by these bare shadows, shape and nothing more,
See, Lord, at Thy service low lies here a heart
Lost, all lost in wonder at the God Thou art.

Seeing, touching, tasting are in Thee deceived;
How says trusty hearing? that shall be believed;
What God’s Son has told me, take for truth I do;
Truth Himself speaks truly, or there’s nothing true.

On the Cross Thy Godhead made no sign to men;
Here Thy very manhood steals from human ken:
Both are my confession, both are my belief,
And I pray the prayer of the dying thief.

I am not like Thomas, wounds I cannot see,
But can plainly call Thee Lord and God as he;
This faith each day deeper be my holding of,
Daily make me harder hope and dearer love.

O Thou our reminder of Christ crucified,
Living Bread, the life of us for whom He died,
Lend this life to me then: feed and feast my mind,
There be Thou the sweetness man was meant to find.

Bring the tender tale true of the Pelican;
Bathe me, Jesu Lord, in what Thy bosom ran—
Blood that but one drop of has the world to win
All the world forgiveness of its world of sin.

Jesu, whom I look at shrouded here below,
I beseech Thee send me what I thirst for so,
Some day to gaze on Thee face to face in light
And be blest for ever with Thy glory’s sight.
