prayers.title: An Exact Confession of All My Offences
prayers.full_text: To thee, O merciful Jesus, in the bitterness of my soul, I come, beseeching thee to have compassion on me, and deliver me from my sins; despise not, O God, the cries of thy lost sheep; reject not the sighs of thy prodigal child, who desires to return home to thee, and to be received again into the number of thy servants. I am sorry for all the sins I have committed, and detest them here in thy presence; because I love thee above all things, and honor thee as my gracious God, worthy of infinite love; and for this reason I now firmly purpose to suffer all evils, nay, even death itself, rather than willingly consent to sin. I resolve to make an exact confession of all my offences, faithfully to discharge whatever shall be enjoined for my punishment or amendment, and carefully to avoid all occasions of sin. And if anything be wanting of true contrition to this my sorrow, may thy sacred passion, O blessed Jesus, thy precious Blood and infinite merits, supply all the defects of my weakness; for it is in thy death I place all my trust; through thee I firmly hope to obtain pardon of all my sins, grace to overcome my vicious customs, and perseverance to the end in the good resolutions I have now made in thy presence. As, therefore, it is by thee I come to the knowledge of my misery, so it is by thee my good purpose and sorrow for my offences must be perfected. May the fire, therefore, of divine love now inflame my soul, and consume therein whatever is displeasing to thy infinite goodness. Sanctify my heart — purify my affections and desires — that, dying to myself, I may ever live to thee, and at length depart this life in thy grace and favor. Amen.

prayers.title: Thou Hast Bidden Me Go in Peace
prayers.full_text: O God of infinite goodness! who hast shown such mercy to a miserable sinner! O most indulgent Father! who hast received once more thy prodigal child, how shall I thank thee! how shall I testify the joy and gratitude that fill my heart? O that I could worthily thank thee, my good God! and acknowledge as I ought, that infinite mercy which forgiveth all my iniquities, which healeth all my diseases. O! that I could now be heard all over the world. I would publish to all sinners, that thou art a God compassionate and merciful, who wilt not always be angry, nor threaten for ever. I would invite all who ever had the misfortune of offending thee, to return with their whole hearts, that they may enjoy with me the bliss of having been received into thy grace and favour. Thou wouldst receive them no less mercifully than thou receivedst me; for as a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear him. My God, thou hast broken the bonds of my sins: thou hast blotted out, with thy own precious blood, the sentence of eternal death which stood against me; thou hast snatched me almost from the brink of hell, and delivered me from the power of the devil, who has now no claim to my soul: as far as the east is from the west, so far hast thou removed my iniquities from me, and by the mouth of thy minister thou hast desired the most unworthy of all sinners to "Go in peace." O divine Jesus! I have obeyed thy command, my heart rejoices, my soul is truly at peace, because I hope I am no longer thy enemy; because thou hast received me with mercy and forgiveness, and satisfied the first and only desire of my heart.

prayers.title: Under All Rebuke to Humble Myself, and to Bear It Meekly
prayers.full_text: O Lord God, O Judge, just, strong, and patient, who knowest the frailty and sinfulness of men, be Thou my strength and my whole confidence; for my own conscience sufficeth me not. Thou knowest what I know not; and therefore ought I under all rebuke to humble myself, and to bear it meekly. Therefore mercifully forgive me as often as I have not done this, and grant me the next time the grace of greater endurance. For better unto me is Thine abundant pity for the attainment of Thy pardon, than the righteousness which I believe myself to have for defence against my conscience, which lieth wait against me. Although I know nothing against myself, yet I am not hereby justified, because if Thy mercy were removed away, in Thy sight should no man living be justified.

prayers.title: A Guilty Conscience Eased by Confession and Pardon
prayers.full_text:
While I keep silence, and conceal
My heavy guilt within my heart,
What torments doth my conscience feel!
What agonies of inward smart!

I spread my sins before the Lord,
And all my secret faults confess;
Thy gospel speaks a pard'ning word,
Thine Holy Spirit seals the grace.

For this shall every humble soul
Make swift addresses to thy seat;
When floods of huge temptations roll,
There shall they find a bless'd retreat.

How safe beneath thy wings I lie,
When days grow dark and storms appear;
And when I walk, thy watchful eye
Shall guide me safe from every snare.

prayers.title: Confession and Forgiveness
prayers.full_text:
Happy the man to whom his God
No more imputes his sin,
But, washed in the Redeemer's blood,
Hath made his garments clean!

Happy beyond expression he
Whose debts are thus discharged;
And from the guilty bondage free,
He feels his soul enlarged.

His spirit hates deceit and lies,
His words are all sincere;
He guards his heart, he guards his eyes,
To keep his conscience clear.

While I my inward guilt suppressed,
No quiet could I find;
Thy wrath lay burning in my breast,
And racked my tortured mind.

Then I confessed my troubled thoughts,
My secret sins revealed;
Thy pard'ning grace forgave my faults,
Thy grace my pardon sealed.

This shall invite thy saints to pray;
When like a raging flood
Temptations rise, our strength and stay
Is a forgiving God.

prayers.title: A Prayer to Be Said by Debtors
prayers.full_text: O almighty God, who art rich unto all, the treasury and fountain of all good, of all justice, and all mercy, and all bounty, to whom we owe all that we are, and all that we have, being thy debtors by reason of our sins, and by thy own gracious contract made with us in Jesus Christ; teach me, in the first place to perform all my obligations to thee, both of duty and thankfulness; and next, enable me to pay my duty to all my friends, and my debts to all my creditors, that none be made miserable or lessened in his estate by his kindness to me, or traffic with me. Forgive me all those sins and irregular actions by which I entered into debt further than my necessity required, or by which such necessity was brought upon me; but let not them suffer by occasion of my sin. Lord, reward all their kindness into their bosoms, and make them recompense where I cannot, and make me very willing in all that I can, and able for all that I am obliged to; or, if it seem good in thine eyes to afflict me by the continuance of this condition, yet make it up by some means to them, that the prayer of thy servant may obtain of thee, at least, to pay my debt in blessings. Amen.

prayers.title: Lord, Sanctify and Forgive All That I Have Tempted to Evil
prayers.full_text: Lord, sanctify and forgive all that I have tempted to evil by my discourse or my example, instruct them in the right way whom I have led to error, and let me never run further on the score of sin; but do thou blot out all the evils I have done by the sponge of thy passion, and the blood of thy cross, and give me a deep and an excellent repentance, and a free and a gracious pardon, that thou mayest answer for me, O Lord, and enable me to stand upright in judgment; for in thee, O Lord, have I trusted, let me never be confounded. Pity me and instruct me, guide me and support me, pardon me and save me, for my sweet Saviour Jesus Christ's sake. Amen.

prayers.title: Acts of Charity
prayers.full_text: O Lord God, I do from henceforth resolve to love my neighbour as myself, and to love Him not in word only, but in deed and in truth. I do from my heart forgive all men their tresspasses, do Thou, Lord, forgive them also. Lord, bless them that hate me, and do good to them that have any way despitefully used me, O repay them good for evil. O my God, bless all those that I have any way wronged; have mercy on all those to whose sins I have been any way accessary, and give them all grace to forgive me. Amen, Amen.

prayers.title: A Most Devout Act of Contrition
prayers.full_text: Here I cast myself at thy feet: consider not in what manner, at what time, and how late: consider only that I come. But, ah! Lord, in how miserable a condition! how filthy! how abominable! Clad with the deformity of my sins, covered with the filthiness of my offences, and defiled with the abominations of a vicious life! But, in approaching thee, O my God, I come with the confidence of finding in thy mercy a secure haven; in thy compassion, protection; in thy clemency, a refuge; and in thy goodness, a remedy. Wherefore, O Lord, under the dread of thy justice, I seek no other remedy, save that of thy mercy, nor fly to any other shelter, but that of thy clemency. In thee I place my trust, O my God: for though by sin I have lost the nature and privilege of a son, yet thou, O Lord, infinitely good, dost not lose the nature and condition thou hast of a father. Let then, O Lord, thy infinite grace complete that work in me which thy infinite mercy has begun. Let thy clemency come to the succor of thy miserable creature: take pity and compassion on my poor soul. I am firmly resolved, with the aid of thy grace, to amend my life, confess my sins, and persevere in thy service; to pardon injuries, avoid the occasions of evil, and abhor my vices, to make such restitution as I am able; and to observe, as in duty bound, all thy commandments. I trust, O Lord, in thy infinite goodness, that thou wilt pardon all my sins, through the death and passion of my Lord Jesus Christ: for though in his wounds there is justice to punish me, yet in the same wounds there is likewise mercy to forgive me. Mercy! mercy! mercy! Jesus, have mercy upon me.

prayers.title: A Prayer for Grace to Use Our Speech Aright
prayers.full_text: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth, and keep the door of my lips, that nothing may proceed thence, but what shall be in some way or other good for the use of edifying. Help me to keep my mouth as with a bridle, when I am provoked to speak unadvisedly with my lips. And let no profane or filthy speeches proceed out of my mouth; nor any thing be said by me that ought not to be named among Christians. O Lord, open thou my lips, that my mouth may show forth thy praise. Make me forward to speak for thee, and for the service of thy truth, and the glory of thy name; but slow to speak any evil whereby I may defile myself, or hurt my neighbour. Give me, Lord, a considerate mind, to weigh what is fit to be said: and make me wise and serious, sober and modest, pious and charitable in what I speak: that it may be without offence, but not without profit to those who hear it. O fill my heart with such grace that, out of the good treasure, I may be ever producing somewhat to benefit the company and to advance thy glory. And put such thoughts into my mind, and such words into my mouth, that my tongue may be as the pen of a ready writer to utter things seasonable and acceptable for the good of my associates.

prayers.title: A Prayer for Our Enemies
prayers.full_text: O Lord of love, and Prince of peace, who hast told us, that thou camest to send a sword and fire upon earth, and that through much tribulation we must enter into thy kingdom; what am I, vile, sinful creature, that I should hope to be exempted from the common portion of all thy followers? If I have raised up enemies to myself by my own misconduct, Lord, incline and enable me to appease and gain them: and so direct my ways to please thee, that my enemies may be constrained to be at peace with me. As for such as are my enemies wrongfully, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge: but forgive them, and open their eyes, and pacify their minds, and turn their hearts, that they may see their error; and, being first reconciled unto thee, may learn to dwell with their brethren in unity and godly love. If, while I study, as much as lieth in me, to live peaceably with them, they still render evil for good, enable me to requite them with nothing but good; and evermore to love my enemies, according to thy command, and according to thy example which thou hast showed us in dying for thine enemies. Let me, in all that I suffer from them, consider them as thy rod, and the staff of thine indignation: that, instead of striving to avenge myself, I may humbly submit to thy fatherly corrections.

prayers.title: Resolution of Amends and Reconciliation
prayers.full_text:
By the help of thy Grace, O Merciful God, I am ready now to walk in those Statutes, which I have formerly transgressed; and to give again, whatsoever I have at any time unjustly taken away; and to make full amends to the uttermost of my Power, for all the Wrong and Damage which I have ever done to any. And where, either by my Example, or by my Counsel and Perswasion, or by my Importunities, I have tempted others, and drawn them into Sin; It shall be the Study and Care of my Life, to make them sensible of the Heinousness, and extream Danger thereof, as, thro the Blessing of thy Grace I am, to recover them out of the same. God be merciful to me a Returning Sinner.
I am contented, O Holy Father, to submit my self to those, who have just cause to be offended with me, and to use all fair ways of Reconciling my self to them, before I hope for Reconciliation and Peace with thee. I freely forgive all those, that have Trespassed against me, and with good Will offer them my Pardon, as I most heartily desire thine. And my Hearty Desire and Purpose is, to study doing Good to my Brethren in their Needs, that I may not be held unworthy to receive it from thee in mine own; and to shew Mercy unto others that I may not be ashamed to ask it for my self, and that the Rigorousness and Unrelenting hardness of my own Dealings towards them, may not deprive me of the favourable Indulgence, and Mercifulness of thy Dealings towards me. God be merciful to me, and forgive me, a Merciful and Forgiving Sinner.

prayers.full_text: O Lord God, Almighty and All-merciful, cleanse those whom I have defiled, heal those whom I have wounded, strengthen those whom I have enfeebled, set right those whom I have misled, recall to Thyself those whom I have alienated from Thee. I pray Thee, save these sinners, save all sinners, and amongst all sinners save me the sinner. For Jesus' sake, the Friend of sinners. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer to God, for the Removal of Vices and Obtaining of Virtues
prayers.full_text: O God, my Mercy, I pray Thee by Thy well-beloved Son, give me works of mercy, practice of piety; to sympathise with the afflicted, to help the needy, to succour the miserable, to counsel the erring, to comfort the sorrowful, to raise up the oppressed, to refresh the poor, to soothe the tearful, to forgive my debtors, to spare them that sin against me, to love them that hate me; for evil to return good; to despise none, but to honour all; to imitate the good, to avoid the bad; to embrace virtues, to reject vices; give me in adversity, patience; in prosperity, continence; watchfulness of mouth, and a guard to the door of my lips; to trample upon earthly things, to long for heavenly things.

prayers.title: Prayer of One Who Has Enemies
prayers.full_text:
Grant me, O Lord, such a quiet, meek, and peaceable mind, that I may not retain grudge and hatred in my heart, nor let the sun go down upon my wrath, but before nightfall, and ere I fall asleep, may heartily forgive my adversaries. Grant me strength that, when my enemy reviles me, I may be like a deaf person, who hears not, and like a dumb person, who opens not his mouth. On the other hand, grant me grace that I may be able to rejoice when my enemy prospers; that I may wish him all possible good, and be pleased when he obtains it; yea, that I may gladly assist him and do good to him whenever he fares ill.

Preserve me from betraying any enmity either in words, or gestures, or deeds; but let me with all my heart be as merciful towards my enemies as towards everybody else. Let me be kindly-spoken, sincere, pleasant in address, and also kind in actions, lest by my unforgiving spirit my prayer be hindered and all my worship and my devotion become reprobate. Grant that I may heartily forgive those who trespass against me, even as I would that Thou shouldest graciously forgive my faults and iniquities, lest I daily pray against myself.

Amen.

prayers.title: Keep Me, O Lord, for I Am Thine by Creation
prayers.full_text: Keep me, O Lord, for I am thine by creation; guide me, for I am thine by purchase; thou hast redeemed me by the blood of thy Son; and loved me with the love of a father, for I am thy child by adoption and grace: let thy mercy pardon my sins, thy providence secure me from the punishments and evils I have deserved, and thy care watch over me, that I may never any more offend thee: make me, in malice, to be a child; but in understanding, piety, and the fear of God, let me be a perfect man in Christ, innocent and prudent, readily furnished and instructed to every good work.

prayers.title: Lord, I Know Not What Is Before Me This Day
prayers.full_text: Lord, I know not what is before me this day, but Thou knowest. I desire to leave all in Thy hands, and to place myself at Thy disposal. Do for me as Thou seest best. Prosper me in all that I undertake. Give me good success, if it be Thy will. But, if Thou seest that crosses and disappointments are better for me, give me grace to accept them as from Thee. Enable me to bear them meekly and cheerfully, and to say, Father, not my will, but Thine, be done. O my God, make me happy this day in Thy service. Keep my conscience void of offence. Let me do nothing, say nothing, desire nothing, which is contrary to Thy will. Give me a thankful spirit. O for a heart to praise Thee for all that Thou hast given me, and for all Thou hast withheld from me—Amen.

prayers.full_text:
O God, against Thee only have I sinned, and done this evil in Thy sight.

I acknowledge my transgression: and am sorry for my sin.

Turn Thy face from my sins: and put out all my misdeeds.

Lord, be merciful to me, for the merits of Thy Son Jesus Christ: lay not this sin to my charge.

prayers.title: Would That I Could Be Indignant with Myself
prayers.full_text: Would that I could weep for my sins, as I have wept for some passing disquiet or disappointment. Would that I could be indignant with myself for having slighted Thee, O my God, as I have been indignant and angered with those who I thought slighted me. Would that I could be on fire against myself, so as, by Thy Grace, to burn out all in me, which even now displeaseth Thee. But, if I cannot weep, let me at least hold fast to Thy sacred Feet, as the anchor of my salvation, and hold Thee tighter the more the storms assail me. If I have not one tear which Thou mayest gather into Thy bottle, let Thy Precious Blood wash my soul, and be to me for the tears of blood, which, if I could, I would shed for my sins. Give me, O Good Lord, if not tears, at least new repentance which shall issue in newness of life.

prayers.title: As We Add Day to Day, So Sin to Sin
prayers.full_text:
Lord,
as we add day to day
so sin to sin.
The just falleth seven times a day;
and I, an exceeding sinner,
seventy times seven;
a wonderful, a horrible thing, O Lord.
But I turn with groans
from my evil ways,
and I return into my heart,
and with all my heart I turn to Thee,
O God of penitents and Saviour of sinners;
and evening by evening I will return
in the innermost marrow of my soul;
and my soul out of the deep
crieth unto Thee.
I have sinned, O Lord, against Thee,
heavily against Thee;
alas, alas, woe is me! for my misery.
I repent, O me! I repent, spare me, O Lord,
I repent, O me, I repent,
help Thou my impenitence.
Be appeased, spare me, O Lord;
be appeased, have mercy on me;
I said, Lord, have mercy upon me,
heal my soul, for I have sinned against Thee.
Have mercy upon me, O Lord,
after Thy great goodness,
according to the multitude of Thy mercies
do away mine offences.

prayers.title: Evening Prayer for Tuesday
prayers.full_text:
Alas, my God, how swiftly the day has passed! As an arrow shot from the bow, so swiftly our years fly. Therefore make me to know mine end and the measure of my days, what it is, that I may know how frail I am. Behold, Thou hast made my days as an handbreadth, and mine age is as nothing before Thee. We must all appear before the judgment-seat of Christ, that every one may receive the things done in the body, according to that he hath done, whether it be good or bad. Therefore I enter into judgment with myself and inquire, My soul, how hast thou spent this day? Hast thou thought upon anything good? Has God remained united with thee, or hast thou driven Him from thee by deliberate and conscious sins? My mouth, what hast thou spoken to-day? Hast thou spoken what is honest, chaste, and of good report? Hast thou spread abroad the praise of God? Or hast thou overflowed with filthiness and foolish talking? Whither have ye gone, my feet? What acts have ye performed and committed, my hands? To what have ye listened, my ears? At what have ye looked, my eyes? What has been thy desire, study, and aim to-day, my heart?

O my God, if I am to answer all these questions, how shall I stand? O Lord, with the passing of this day remove my transgressions. O Jesus, blot out my sins with Thy holy blood. O Holy Spirit, assure me of the forgiveness of all my sins before I fall asleep. When I am thus acquitted of my guilt, O Triune God, I shall calmly go to sleep, and to-morrow I shall be the more diligent to avoid all that may grieve Thee. My Father, let Thy love cover me and mine. My Jesus, in Thy wounds I rest in peace and safety. O Holy Spirit, before I fall asleep, do Thou breathe in my heart the last sigh with which I commend my spirit into the hands of God.

prayers.title: Forgive Me the Things Whereof My Conscience Is Afraid
prayers.full_text:
But that I may serve Thee with a quiet mind, forgive me the things whereof my conscience is afraid, and avert the judgments which I have justly deserved. Remember not the offences of my youth; and in mercy blot out those of my riper years. Pardon my sins of the day past, and of my life past, and grant that they may never rise up in judgment against me. Amen.

"If any man sin, we have an Advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous, and He is the propitiation for our sins."—1 John ii. 1.

O most powerful Advocate, I put my cause into Thy hands; let Thy blood and merits plead for me, and by Thy mighty intercession procure for me a full discharge of all my sins.

"Sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee."—John v. 14.

Lord, the frailty of man without Thee cannot but fall. In all temptations, therefore, I beseech Thee to succour me, that no sin may ever get the dominion over me.

prayers.title: Give Me Courage to Resist, Patience to Endure, Constancy to Persevere
prayers.full_text: O my God, sweetness unspeakable, turn into bitterness all my fleshly consolation, which draweth me away from the love of eternal things, and wickedly allureth toward itself by setting before me some present delight. Let not, O my God, let not flesh and blood prevail over me, let not the world and its short glory deceive me, let not the devil and his craftiness supplant me. Give me courage to resist, patience to endure, constancy to persevere. Grant, in place of all consolations of the world, the most sweet unction of Thy Spirit, and in place of carnal love, pour into me the love of Thy Name.

prayers.title: The Mess I Made
prayers.full_text:
Lord, look how far down I've fallen.
I knew better and did it anyway.
Now, all I have is the mess I made.
But with You, Jesus, there is always mercy.
Amen.

prayers.title: Body and Soul
prayers.original_title: Almighty God, Who Seest That We Have No Power of Ourselves
prayers.full_text: God, I don't have the power to help myself. Keep me, Lord, body and soul. Guard me from what comes at me, and from what comes out of me. Don't let any of it harm my soul. Through Jesus Christ, our Lord. Amen.
prayers.modern: God, I don't have the power to help myself. Keep me, Lord, body and soul. Guard me from what comes at me, and from what comes out of me. Don't let any of it harm my soul. Through Jesus Christ, our Lord. Amen.
prayers.original: Almighty God, who seest that we have no power of ourselves to help ourselves, keep us both outwardly in our bodies, and inwardly in our souls; that we may be defended from all adversities which may happen to the body, and from all evil thoughts which may assault and hurt the soul; through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Five More Minutes
prayers.full_text:
Five more minutes, God.
That's all I'm asking for today.
I was up late. I got up on time, though.
Took my meds and did my health check.
I've said my prayers, and this is the last one.
Now I just need to lie down.
Five more minutes, God.

It's midday, God.
Made it to work on time.
Working hard, Lord, but I get angry.
Coworker was a jerk.
Another cut me off and walked away.
I'm ready to blow up.
Before I do,
Five more minutes, God.

It's evening, God. I'm stuck in traffic.
People need to learn to drive, Lord.
Cut off here and there.
Turning right in front of me.
I've missed dinner now, Lord.
I'm hungry.
Just give me five more minutes, God.

It's night now, Lord.
The hour I dread.
Truth be told, the day was pretty good.
I know I should be more grateful.
I try, God. I really do.
Lord, You know my temptation.
You know my vice.
I can't see my way through another day.
I'm not sure I can make it through another hour.
So all I ask is Your strength and grace
To hold on five more minutes, God.

It's bedtime, God. I did my best.
The day wasn't too bad.
I tried not to dishonor Your name.
I tried not to be harsh, cruel, or mean.
You know where I fell short.
Thank You for being patient with me,
And thank You for giving me
Five more minutes, God.

I pray this in Your name, Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayers.collection: Kentucky Bootleggers Originals
prayers.note: A Kentucky Bootleggers Original -- Paul's own, written half asleep on getting up ("the five more minutes I asked for turned out to be four more hours of sleep"), revised several times, read by every AI, and settled with Fable 2026-09-21 from ten versions: his most-converged draft with six lines restored from his rough first draft and one from a middle one (the record is in the import script, tools/prayer_prepass/import_five_more_minutes_2026_09_21.py). One day in five stanzas, morning to bedtime, the same refrain closing each; in the morning it is a joke about sleep, by night it is survival, and no stanza explains what the five minutes are for. "Cut off" at work and again in traffic is kept on purpose: the day's pattern, literal the second time. THE ENDING is Paul's ruling: the intercession seal "in Your name and through Your blood" is "the spiritual equivalent of an exclamation point" and excessive for ordinary conversation with God, "almost like a magic charm", so this closes plainly. Tagged both ends of the day because it is a whole-day prayer; step-10 for the bedtime stanza's nightly inventory, appended last and unranked to the Step 10 shelf, placement his. [2026-10-16, faith line and subtitle (Paul): faith Christian (kb); tradition was "Ecumenical Christian — Kentucky Bootleggers Original (2026)"; attribution was "Kentucky Bootleggers, 2026.".]

prayers.title: Light That Never Goes Out
prayers.full_text: Lord Jesus Christ, Light that never goes out: here I am, risen from my bed to serve You. Do not let me fall back into the sleep of sin and sloth, but strengthen me with Your grace to go forward without fear. Do not let this day be wasted; fill it with deeds of love and faithfulness. Amen.

prayers.title: Set Us on Our Feet
prayers.full_text: Lord our God, You have raised us from the sleep of the night and given us the light of this day. Drive from us all sluggishness and heaviness of body and soul. Set us on our feet, so that we may begin the work of Your commandments with zeal and joy. Direct our hands to every useful task, so that by upright deeds we may praise Your holy name all day long. Amen.

Drive from us all laziness and every negligence that weighs down our resolve, and strengthen our hands to do what pleases You on this new day. Through Christ Jesus our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Morning of Light, Righteous Sun
prayers.full_text:
Morning of light, righteous Sun, let Your light dawn on me.
You who come forth from the Father, bring forth from my soul a word that pleases You.
Treasure of mercy, make me the finder of Your hidden treasure.
Door of mercy, open to me who confess You, and give me a place among those on high.
Three in One, who care for all that You have made, have mercy on me also.
Awake, Lord, to help me; awaken me from my numbness, to be like the angels who never sleep.

Shake the heaviness of sleep from my eyes, and kindle in my heart the flame of Your love and zeal for good works, so that I may rise quickly and walk in Your ways without stumbling. Amen.

Drive from my heart the storm of useless thoughts, the fear that makes me fainthearted, and the confusion that wounds my soul. Still the waves of trouble and sorrow that toss me about, and plant in me Your peace, which passes all understanding, so that in quietness of spirit I may do Your will all the days of my life. Amen.

Thine Holy Spirit, O Lord,
Which Thou didst send forth upon Thine holy disciples
and the honourable Apostles at the Third Hour,
Take not This from us, O Thou Good! but renew Him within us!
Create in me a clean heart, O God! and renew a right spirit within me.
Cast me not away from Thy presence, and take not Thine Holy Spirit from me.

prayers.title: The Nicene Creed
prayers.full_text:
We believe in one God, the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth, of everything seen and unseen.

We believe in one Lord, Jesus Christ, the only Son of the Father, who was with Him before the world was made: Light from Light, true God from true God, begotten, not made, equal to the Father in His divinity. Through Him everything came to be; without Him nothing came to be, nothing in heaven and nothing on earth. For us human beings and for our salvation He came down from heaven. He became human, taking flesh from the Holy Spirit and from Mary, the holy Virgin. He became a man and was crucified for us in the days of Pontius Pilate. He suffered, died, and was buried, and on the third day He rose from the dead, as the holy Scriptures say. He went up in glory into heaven and sat down at His Father's right hand. He will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead, and His kingdom will have no end.

We believe in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of life, who proceeds from the Father. With the Father and the Son we worship and glorify Him. He spoke through the prophets.

We believe in one holy Church, universal and apostolic. We believe in one baptism for the forgiveness of sins. We look forward to the resurrection of the dead and the life to come, forever and ever. Amen.

Through Him everything came to be; without Him nothing came to be, nothing in heaven and nothing on earth. For us human beings and for our salvation He came down from heaven. He became human, taking flesh from the Holy Spirit and from Mary, the holy Virgin. He became a man and was crucified for us in the days of Pontius Pilate. He suffered, died, and was buried, and on the third day He rose from the dead, as the holy Scriptures say. He went up in glory into heaven and sat down at His Father's right hand. He will come again in glory to judge the living and the dead, and His kingdom will have no end.

We believe in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of life, who proceeds from the Father. With the Father and the Son we worship and glorify Him. He spoke through the prophets.

We believe in one holy Church, universal and apostolic. We believe in one baptism for the forgiveness of sins. We look forward to the resurrection of the dead and the life to come, forever and ever. Amen.
prayers.original: We believe in one God the Lord the Father almighty, maker of the heavens and the earth, the visible and the invisible. And we believe in one Lord Jesus Christ the only Son of the Father, who was with him before the world was created, light of light, God of very God, begotten not made, equal with the Father in his godhead: by whom all things were made but without him was not anything made, neither in heaven nor in earth: who for us men and for our salvation came down from heaven and was incarnate of the Holy Ghost and of Mary, of the holy virgin: he was made man and was crucified for us in the days of Pontius Pilate, he suffered and died and was buried and rose again from the dead the third day, as it is written in the holy scriptures: he ascended with glory into the heavens and sat down on the right hand of his Father: he shall come again with glory to judge the quick and the dead and of his kingdom there shall be no end. And we believe in the Holy Ghost the Lord, the giver of life, who proceedeth from the Father: we worship and glorify him with the Father and the Son: who spake by the prophets. And we believe in one holy church catholic apostolic and we believe in one baptism for the remission of sin and we look for the resurrection of the dead and the life to come world without end. Amen.

prayers.title: I Bow Down to the Father
prayers.full_text:
I bow down to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit in a single act of worship. (Say three times.) They are One and yet Three, Three and yet One: three Persons, one God.

I bow down before our Lady Mary, the Virgin, the Mother of God.

I bow down before the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, made holy by His precious blood. The Cross is our power. The Cross is our strength. The Cross is our redemption. The Cross is the salvation of our souls. Some denied it, but we believed, and we who believed were saved by the power of His Cross. Amen.

prayers.title: Glory to the Father
prayers.full_text:
Glory to the Father, glory to the Son, glory to the Holy Spirit. (Say three times.)

Praise to our Lady Mary, the Virgin, the Mother of God. Praise to the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ.

May Christ remember us in His mercy. When He comes again, may He not put us to shame. May He wake us to praise His name and keep us strong in worshiping Him.

Our Lady Mary, lift up our prayer, and ask forgiveness for our sins before the throne of our Lord.

He gave us this bread to eat and this cup to drink. He provided our food and our clothing. He has been patient with all our sins. He gave us His holy body and His precious blood. He saved us from the death of sin, and He has brought us to this hour. So let us give glory and thanks to Him, to God Most High, and praise to His Virgin Mother and His precious Cross. May the name of the Lord our God be thanked and praised always, at every time and every hour. Amen.

prayers.original:
Glory to the Father, glory to the Son, glory to the Holy Spirit!
(Say three times.)
Praise to our Lady Mary, the Virgin, the Mother of God!
Praise to the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ!

In His mercy may Christ remember us.
On the day of His second coming
may He spare us shame.
May He rouse us to the praise of His name
and hold us steady as we worship Him.

Our Lady Mary,
carry our prayer to the throne of our Lord,
and ask Him there to forgive our sins.

To Him who fed us this bread
and gave us this cup to drink,
who has seen to our food
and the clothes on our backs,
who has been patient with every one of our sins,
who gave us His holy body
and His precious blood,
who saved us out of the death of sin
and has brought us all the way to this hour:
to God Most High be glory and thanks!
Praise to His Virgin Mother, praise to His precious Cross!
Thanks and glory to the name of the Lord our God,
always, in every season, at every hour. Amen.

prayers.full_text: Peace be with you, Mary, our mother. We bow in honor and ask you to pray for us. We have run to you for shelter from the beast that hunts us. For the sake of your mother Anna and your father Joachim, holy Virgin, ask for God's blessing on our community today. Amen.

prayers.title: My Soul Magnifies the Lord
prayers.full_text: My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in my God and my Savior, because He has looked on the lowliness of His servant. From now on every generation will call me blessed, because He has done great and mighty things for me, and His name is holy. His mercy reaches from generation to generation to those who fear Him. He has shown the strength of His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts. He has brought the powerful down from their thrones and lifted up the humble. He has filled the hungry with His blessings and sent the rich away empty. He has received His servant Israel and remembered His mercy, as He said to our ancestors, to Abraham and his descendants forever.

prayers.original: My soul doth magnify the Lord, and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour. For he hath regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed. For he that is mighty hath done to me great things; and holy is his name. And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation. He hath shewed strength with his arm; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts. He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree. He hath filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he hath sent empty away. He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy; as he spake to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever.

prayers.title: First Prayer - Morning Prayer of the Covenant
prayers.full_text:
God the Father, Giver of light, strength of all things, You who watch over every soul: Light who was before the world began, Maker of the world, Guide to life, Giver of joy that never dies.

You brought us out of the snares of darkness and gave us a light we could never have found on our own. You set free from their chains those who believe in You, and You shielded us with faith.

You are never far from Your servants; You are always with them. You never close Your ears to the soul that asks of You in fear and trembling. You know everything before we think it, and You search us before a thought takes shape. Before we ask, You give us what we long for, as You will, and You hear us when we call on You without doubting. You are Light beyond words, King of the armies of heaven. You hear the archangels' song of praise, and You rest above them.

Hear us, Lord, we pray. As we trust in You, give us a word that never falls silent. We praise You, we thank You, we bless You. Because You are our refuge, we Your servants give You glory, Lord.

(All:) We give You glory, Lord.

God the Father, Giver of light,
strength of all that is, You who visit every soul;
Light from the beginning, Maker of the world,
Guide into life,
Giver of a joy that will not die:

You led us out of the stumbling dark
and gave us the light we could not reach.
You untied the bonds of everyone who believes in You,
and sheltered us in faith.

You never go far from Your servants;
You stay with them always.
You are not deaf to the soul
that asks You, shaking and afraid.
You know it all before we think;
You search us before we think.
Before we ask, You give our heart's desire, as You will,
and when we call and do not doubt, You hear us.

Light beyond all telling,
King of heaven's armies,
You hear the archangels sing,
and You rest upon them.

Hear us, Lord, we beg You!
Give us a trusting word
that will not go quiet.
It is You we praise, You we thank, You we bless;
we take refuge in You,
and we, Your servants, glorify You, Lord.

(All:) It is You we glorify, Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Morning Prayer of the Covenant: Second Prayer - The Sun That Never Sets
prayers.full_text:
Lord Jesus Christ, Holy One, You have heard us.

To the mute You became a voice, to the broken a staff to lean on, to the blind light, to the lame a road, and to lepers a cleansing. Lord, You healed those in the grip of sickness, and You brought healing to the deaf.

You rebuked death and crushed the darkness. You made the light: a sun that never sets, a lamp that never goes out, a sun that always shines on Your holy ones. By Your good will You set everything firmly in place to make the world beautiful.

You dawned for all to see, salvation for humankind and the restorer of the soul, and You planned all things rightly from the start.

Maker of angels, Father of all things, the beauty of the world and the foundation of the earth! Wisdom and Knowledge from the Father, who was before all things, was sent into the world, a Being that cannot be destroyed or explained, the unseen Spirit.

You are the glorious Messenger, and Your name is wonderful. For this, we Your servants praise You, Lord.

(All:) We praise You, Lord.

You have heard us, Holy One.
You became the voice of the mute,
the staff of the broken,
the light of the blind,
the road of the lame,
the cleansing of the leper.
Lord, You healed those whom sickness had seized,

You rebuked death
and tormented the dark.
You made light:
a sun that will not go down,
a lamp no one can put out,
a sun forever shining on the saints.
By Your steady good will
You planted all things
so the world would be beautiful.

You rose like the sun for everyone to see,
salvation for humankind,
the One who brings the soul back;
long ago You thought out all things as they should be.

Maker of angels, Father of all things,
beauty of the world,
the One who laid the earth's foundations!
Wisdom and Knowledge from the Father,
who was from the beginning,
was sent into the world:
a Being nothing can destroy,
beyond all explaining,
the unseen Spirit.

Glorious Herald,
wonderful is Your name,
and this is why we, Your servants, extol You, Lord.

(All:) It is You we extol, Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Morning Prayer of the Covenant: Third Prayer - Be a Refuge for Us All
prayers.full_text:
Three times over we offer You this holy praise. You gave us Your faith, which nothing can tear down, and by it You made us able to overcome the chains of death. You created upright minds in those who believe in You, so that, though human, they may be called gods. By the Spirit You gave us power to trample all the strength of the enemy, so that we can untie what cannot be untied. You brought us into love with Your Father and made peace between us.

Lord, hear those who call on You. Lord, do not let us who pray to You be despised; let the accusation fall on our enemy instead. Give us constant prayer, so that we are kept from being swallowed up by the enemy.

Hear us, eternal King: comfort widows, take in orphans, cleanse the unclean in Your mercy, make the foolish wise, bring back the lost, save those in prison, and be a refuge for all of us. For Yours, Lord our God, is the blessed kingdom.

(All:) Amen.

Three times over we offer You this holy praise. You gave us Your faith, which nothing can tear down, and by it You made us able to overcome the chains of death. You created upright minds in those who believe in You, so that, though human, they may be called gods. By the Spirit You gave us power to trample all the strength of the enemy, so that we can untie what cannot be untied. You brought us into love with Your Father and made peace between us.

Lord, hear those who call on You. Lord, do not let us who pray to You be despised; let the accusation fall on our enemy instead. Give us constant prayer, so that we are kept from being swallowed up by the enemy.

Hear us, eternal King: comfort widows, take in orphans, cleanse the unclean in Your mercy, make the foolish wise, bring back the lost, save those in prison, and be a refuge for all of us. For Yours, Lord our God, is the blessed kingdom.

(All:) Amen.
prayers.original:
A third time we bring You this holy praise.
To us You gave Your own faith,
a faith nothing can tear down,
and with it You made us strong enough
to break the chains of death.
You formed a right mind
in everyone who believes in You,
so that, human though they are,
they may be called gods.
Through the Spirit You put the enemy's whole power
under our feet,
so that we can untie the knot no one can untie.
You made Your Father's love ours,
and You stood among us and made peace.

Hear, Lord, everyone who asks of You.
Lord, let no one look down on us who pray to You;
when the accusing comes, let us stand over our enemy.
Give us prayer that never stops,
and keep us out of the enemy's jaws.

Hear us, King of the ages:
comfort the widow,
take the orphan in,
by Your mercy, wash the stained clean,
give the foolish wisdom,
bring the lost back,
save those in chains,
and be a shelter for us all.
For the blessed kingdom is Yours, Lord our God.

(All:) Amen.

prayers.title: I Sign Myself with the Cross
prayers.full_text:
I sign my face and my whole self with the sign of the cross. (Say three times.)

In the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit, one God.

Believing in the Holy Trinity and putting myself in God's hands, I renounce you, Satan, my enemy, here before my mother, the holy Church, Mary of Zion, who is my witness, forever and ever. Amen.

prayers.full_text:
We thank You, Lord, and we praise You. We bless You, Lord, and we trust in You. We worship You, Lord, and we serve Your holy name. We bow down before You, to whom every knee bows and whom every tongue serves.

You are the God of gods, the Lord of lords, and the King of kings. You are the God of all flesh and of every soul. And we call on You as Your holy Son taught us, when He said, "When you pray, say":

_(Continue with the Lord's Prayer, entry 56.)_

prayers.title: The Lord's Prayer, in the Ethiopian Form
prayers.full_text:
Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.
Your kingdom come, Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread. Forgive us our wrongs and our sins, as we forgive those who wrong us.
Lord, lead us not into temptation, but save us and deliver us from all evil.
For Yours is the kingdom, the power, and the glory, forever and ever. Amen.

Our Father in heaven, may Your name be kept holy.
May Your kingdom come and Your will be done, as it is in heaven, so on earth.
Give us today our bread for each day.
Forgive us our wrongs and our sins, as we too forgive whoever has wronged us.
Lord, do not lead us into temptation, but save us and rescue us from all evil.
For Yours is the kingdom, the power and the glory, forever and ever. Amen.

prayers.full_text: With the greeting of the holy angel Gabriel: O my Lady Mary, peace be with you, virgin in mind and virgin in body. Mother of the Lord of hosts, peace be with you. You are blessed among women, and the fruit of your womb is blessed. Rejoice, joyful one, full of grace; the Lord is with you. Ask and pray to your beloved Son, Jesus Christ, for mercy on us, that He may forgive us our sins.

prayers.title: Ilia Chavchavadze's Prayer: Not Riches, Not Glory
prayers.full_text:
Our Father in heaven,
I kneel before You with a humble heart.
I do not ask You for riches or for glory;
I will not dishonor holy prayer by asking for them.
What I thirst for is a soul made bright from heaven,
a heart set on fire with love for Your commandments,
so that even for my enemies, though they drive a dagger into my heart,
I may ask You: "Forgive them, O God; they do not know what they do!"

prayers.title: Morgensegen: Into Your Hands I Commend Myself
prayers.full_text: I thank You, my heavenly Father, through Jesus Christ, Your dear Son, that You have kept me this night from all harm and danger; and I ask You to keep me this day also from sin and every evil, so that all I do and all my life may please You. For into Your hands I entrust myself, my body and soul, and all things. Let Your holy angel be with me, so that the evil foe may find no power over me. Amen.

prayers.title: Deliver Me from Forgetfulness
prayers.full_text: Lord, rescue me from all ignorance, forgetfulness, and cowardice, and from a heart that has turned to stone. Lord, set me free from every temptation that comes through my thoughts, and from feeling abandoned. Lord, give me a heart that grieves over sin, and tears that bring peace, and clear the thick darkness of gloom out of my heart. Amen.

prayers.full_text: Now that we have risen from sleep, brothers and sisters, let us fall down before the Master and cry out to Him with all our hearts: Lord, rescue us from listlessness and from the sleep of laziness. Wake our minds early to Your works, and guide our hands to the work of Your commandments. Amen.

prayers.title: Awake, My Soul, and Run the Race
prayers.full_text:
Awake, my soul; rise from the dead, and Christ will give you light. Do not give yourself over to the sleep of laziness. Rise before dawn and speak to the Lord. The time for labor has come: rise and run the race, that you may receive the crown of righteousness.

Lord, help me answer this call faithfully. Amen.

prayers.full_text:
The light of day is rising. My soul, throw off the works of darkness and put on the armor of light. Do not remain asleep in carelessness, but stand ready to serve the Lord.

Master, bless the work of my hands at this very hour. Amen.

prayers.title: Prayer to Dispel Mental Confusion
prayers.full_text: Master, Lord Jesus Christ our God, You give Your peace to all people. Still the turmoil of my thoughts. Scatter the dark and harmful imaginings that trouble my soul and drag it down into despondency. Enlighten the eyes of my mind with the light of the knowledge of You, so that I may pass through this day with gentleness and hope. For You are blessed forever and ever. Amen.

prayers.title: Direct My Mind at Dawn
prayers.full_text: My Benefactor, now that I have risen from my bed, I ask You: do not let idleness and forgetfulness hold me down. You have roused me, slothful as I am; now wake and direct my mind at dawn toward Your commandments. Grant me an eagerness that does not give way and a strength that cannot be overcome, so that in all I do I may carry out Your holy will. Amen.

prayers.title: A Day for Service and Repentance
prayers.full_text:
My soul, now that you have risen from sleep, do not linger in bed, lest the evil one find a foothold within you. Come, worship and bow before Christ our King. He has given you this day for service and repentance. Strengthen your hands for work, with your hope anchored in the Lord.

Lord, help me serve You faithfully today. Amen.

prayers.title: Stillness of Soul for This Day
prayers.full_text: Lord, my Maker, see the weakness of my heart and the whirl of my vain cares. Do not let me be swallowed up by anguish and by worries that come before their time, but establish me in unshakable faith in Your providence. Calm my mind, and keep it from every evil wandering; give me deep peace, so that in stillness of soul I may do Your will this day. Amen.

I have risen to do Your will; give me Your grace, so that I do not grow lazy in the hours of this day, but run with zeal in the way of Your commandments. Amen.

prayers.title: The Wind Still Knows That Name
prayers.full_text:
Lord Jesus, You were fast asleep,
a pillow in the stern,
while all the sea came pouring in.
That storm is in my head.

I bail and bail; the water climbs.
I'll do what Your friends did.
I call You by Your name: Jesus!
The wind still knows that name.

You stood up, and the sea lay down.
Stand up inside this storm.
And in the quiet that You make,
I thank You for one thing:

(Name it, out loud or in your heart.)

Amen.

prayers.title: God of All Comfort
prayers.full_text: God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Father of mercies and God of all comfort, You comfort us in all our sorrow. Comfort everyone who grieves, who is saddened, who is despairing, who is tossed about by the spirit of despondency. Every one of us was made by Your hands, made wise by Your wisdom, raised up by Your right hand, glorified by Your goodness… Yet now we are visited by Your fatherly discipline, by sorrows that will not last. You discipline with compassion those You love; You show them generous mercy and look on their tears. So now that You have disciplined us, have mercy on us and ease our sadness. Turn our sorrow into gladness, and mix our sadness with joy. Show us Your wonderful mercy, Master, wonderful in counsel, Lord, beyond understanding in Your judgments, and blessed in Your works forever. Amen.

prayers.original:
God, Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Father of mercies and God of every comfort,
You comfort us in every sorrow!
Comfort everyone who grieves,
everyone sad, everyone near despair,
everyone the spirit of despondency has caught in its storm.
Each of them is the work of Your hands:
You gave them wisdom, Your right hand lifted them up,
You crowned them with Your goodness…
And now Your fatherly discipline has come upon us:
sorrows that will not last!
With compassion You discipline the ones You love;
You are generous with mercy, and You see their tears!
You have disciplined us; now have mercy.
Quiet our sorrow.
Turn our grief into gladness;
let Your joy dissolve our sadness.
Let Your mercy amaze us,
Master, wonderful in counsel,
Lord, whose judgments no one can fathom,
blessed in all You do, forever. Amen.

prayers.title: When the Accuser Speaks
prayers.full_text:
(Say this back to the thought that accuses you.)

You are a slanderer, and you are already condemned; you are not the judge. Judgment belongs to Christ, who came into the world to save sinners. I believe in Him, and I hope to be saved by His grace.

(Then turn to prayer, and hold fast to God's mercy, which no sin can overcome.)

prayers.title: Glory to You, Life-Giving God
prayers.full_text:
The Lord puts an end to my despondency and brings my boldness back to life. The Lord is everything to me. Master, You who truly are, glory to You!

Glory to You, Father, You are Life! Son, You are Life! Holy Spirit, You are Life! One simple Being, without division or composition. God, always rescuing us from the death of the soul that our passions bring.

Glory to You, Lord! Master in three Persons! When we call upon Your name, You brighten the darkened face of our soul and body and You give us Your peace, which is greater than every earthly and bodily good, and beyond all understanding. Amen.

Lord, You are everything to me.
Lord, You are everything to me. By myself I can do nothing, bear nothing, overcome nothing, conquer nothing. You are my strength.

prayers.title: Inspired by St. Silouan: Slow to Learn
prayers.full_text:
Lord Jesus, You taught us to learn humility and meekness from You.
I am slow to learn, my Christ, and You see my sorrow and my tears…
Teach my soul, then, by Your Holy Spirit, the lessons of obedience and temperance.
Amen.

prayers.title: Teach Me Humility and Gentleness
prayers.full_text: Lord, teach me humility and gentleness. By Your Holy Spirit let my soul find rest from this storm of thoughts. Lord, see the sorrow in my heart and the frailty of my mind. Grant me Your grace; quiet my fear and confusion. Teach me to love and trust You all the days of my life. Amen.

prayers.title: A Morning Prayer against Warring Thoughts
prayers.full_text: Lord, heavenly King, look on me in my lowliness and heal my warring thoughts. Drive the darkness of doubt, fear, and bitterness that assails my mind and my soul this morning. Surround me with Your triumphant cross, before this wave of despondency swallows me. Let me serve Your holy will in peace. Amen.

prayers.title: Strength for the Path of Honor
prayers.full_text: Lord, You who raise the dead, You have brought me from the darkness of night into the light of day. Do not let me fall asleep in carelessness and forgetfulness. Strengthen my arm and make my heart firm, that I may not fear hard labor or flee from duty. Lead me in the path of honor and faith in You. Amen.
prayers.modern: Lord, You who raise the dead, You have brought me from the darkness of night into the light of day. Do not let me fall asleep in carelessness and forgetfulness. prayers.original: Jesus, You are the Resurrection and Life. Your hand carried me safely through my dark hours to another dawn. Keep my mind alert. Help me reject idle distractions, always remembering You. Give me strong hands and an unwavering desire to do Your will. Christ, help me face today's work unafraid, never turning my back on what is mine to do. Go before me; keep me true to my word, ever faithful to You. Amen.

prayers.title: You Are My Only Hope
prayers.full_text: Most kind Master, free Your servant from gnawing worry and dark forebodings that torment my mind and drain my strength. Grant me a strong spirit and a clear mind, that I may not fall into despair when this day is hard. Strengthen me by Your truth, for You are my only hope. Amen.

prayers.original: Gracious Lord, I am Yours; rescue me. Fretting eats away at my thinking, and dread of what might be wears me out. Give me courage and a level head to bear the weight of today without giving up hope. Set my feet on what is true. I have no one but You. Amen.

prayers.title: Ground Me in Your Word
prayers.full_text: Loving Creator, rescue me from creeping panic and dread. They attack my peace and steal my endurance. Give me a fierce resolve and help me think straight, so that I do not break under the pressure of today's trials. Ground me in Your unchanging Word. You alone are my rock and my salvation. Amen.

prayers.title: Your Fellow Worker
prayers.full_text: Rise, my soul, before the sun, and greet the One who wakes you! Why lie in the bed of despair and idleness, when the Lord calls you to His field? Shake off the dust of laziness, take up your tools, and go. Lord, bless the beginning of my day and the work of my hands, so that I may not be a servant of idle talk, but Your fellow worker. Amen.
prayers.modern: Rise, my soul, before the sun, and greet the One who wakes you! Why lie in the bed of despair and idleness, when the Lord calls you to His field? Shake off the dust of laziness, take up your tools, and go. Lord, bless the beginning of my day and the work of my hands, so that I may not be a servant of idle talk, but Your fellow worker. Amen.
prayers.original:
Stand up, my spirit! Outrun the daylight.
Welcome your God, who brought you through the night.
Why are you tangled in your blankets, hopeless and doubting?
Our Father has a harvest to bring in and wants you there.
Throw off the blankets, and the sloth with them.
Let's grab our boots and gear and get to work!

Lord, consecrate the start of my morning.
Strengthen my hands to help bring Your harvest in.
Keep me from gossip and useless chatter;
keep me at my work, for You and with You. Amen.

prayers.title: Peace of Heaven and Earth
prayers.full_text: My Lord Jesus Christ, Peace of heaven and earth, give my mind rest from the turmoil of the passions. Clear from my thoughts every care that troubles my soul, and let Your peace, which the world cannot give, dwell in my heart. Enlighten my morning with Your light, so that I may walk in uprightness and in Your fear. Amen.
prayers.modern: My Lord Jesus Christ, Peace of heaven and earth, give my mind rest from the turmoil of the passions. Enlighten my morning with Your light, so that I may walk in uprightness and in Your fear. Amen.
prayers.original:
Be calm, my soul. Still the storm of your impulses.
 One more round with your restless thoughts will not fix a thing.
 Nothing out there can hand you what you are looking for.
 Ask the One who can.

Lord Jesus, Prince of Peace, quiet the cravings that shake me.
 Stop the worries that suffocate me.
 Give me Your peace. Let it settle in me and stay.
 Brighten this day with Your glory.
 Keep me on Your straight path, in awe of You. Amen.

prayers.title: Jesus, Drive the Darkness From My Mind
prayers.full_text:
Lord Jesus Christ, Light that rose before me this morning,
drive the darkness from my mind,
especially the thoughts that draw me away from You.
Wake my heart to the work of righteousness.
I cannot make myself faithful by resolve alone;
give me strength to rise and do Your will this day.
Let me begin with the duty nearest at hand and meet it honestly. Amen.

Lord Jesus, Morning Star, come up and burn off the fog in my head.
 Open my eyes and rouse me to do what is right.
 Give me what it takes to get up and do what You want today. Amen.

prayers.title: Hush the Racket
prayers.full_text:
My God of all comfort, let Your stillness fall on my thinking like dew.
As my eyes open, don't let the rush of the day rattle me.
Hush the racket in my head, and plant Your peace deep in me.
I want to honor You today with a faith nothing can shake. Amen.

prayers.title: The Next Hour
prayers.full_text:
Lord, You have given me this morning.
Wake my mind and turn it toward Your will.
I know how quickly my thoughts run ahead of me,
and how readily I put off the good I ought to do.
Give me the desire to serve You,
even when it does not come easily,
through each hour You grant.
I will begin with what is before me
and ask Your help for the next hour. Amen.

First thing today, Lord, bring me to my senses:
You are in charge, and I am not.
Build in me a drive to be of use,
so that I keep working for You as long as I breathe.

prayers.title: Cover My Head
prayers.full_text:
Strength of the weary, cover my head today.
Let trust in You be my helmet.
When my own thoughts gang up on me, pull me back to Your calm.
We are not afraid of what is coming,
because You hold us up and see us through.
Each new day, let me wake to the relief of being rescued. Amen.

prayers.title: Let It Settle
prayers.full_text:
Jesus my Savior, You outshine the sun. Shine in me.
My head this morning is creek water,
stirred up and muddy with worries about nothing.
Let it settle until it runs clear
and You can shine all the way to the bottom.
Then I can serve You from now till nightfall. Amen.

prayers.original:
Christ my Redeemer, Your radiance is more than the sun's.
Rise in my sight and dispel my gloom.
Snatch me from needless anxiety
and from thinking that only bewilders me.
Make my heart undivided,
so that I can wait on You until evening. Amen.

prayers.title: When Another Road Seems Easier

Lord, send me out to the work of this day.
Guard me from idle company, and from my own wish to waste the hours You have given me.
Set my feet on the way of Your commandments when another road seems easier.
Let me meet the people before me with patience, and do the work given to me faithfully.
I will go out now and keep to Your way. Amen.

prayers.title: I Am Leaving the House

God, I am leaving the house.
Don't let me fall in with loafers, or talk myself into killing the hours.
Hold me to what You commanded when the shortcut looks better.
Help me be slow to snap at whoever is already there,
and finish what was put in my hands.
I am stepping out. Keep me on it. Amen.

prayers.title: Christ, My True Peace
prayers.full_text:
Christ, my true Peace, let Your peace rule my troubled mind this morning.
 Fear makes me tremble, and the worry keeps talking, though I have heard it all before.
 Quiet it. Keep me from taking every thought at its word.
 Your mercy has not changed in the night.
 Let me begin this day calmly, with my hope resting there.
 Now get me up and show me the first task. Amen.

prayers.title: Lift This Night Off Me
prayers.full_text:
Glory to You, Lord Jesus Christ.
I am on my feet while it is still early.
Here is the mess I woke up with. I am handing it to You.
Pity the noise in my head.
Open the blinds that fear pulled down over my mind.
Lift this night off me, Lord.
Run out the worry that ruins my hope.
Keep watch over me with Your peace.
You made the day I am walking into. Amen.

prayers.full_text:
Lord, my mind is a dull blade this morning.
Put an edge on it. I am here to serve, not to drift.
Set a holy fear on me, and a will that moves.
What Your grace alone can do, do in this house.
I am leaving the chair. Amen.

prayers.title: I Call My Delay Rest

Wake my soul from sluggishness, as You have woken my body from sleep.
I know the good You ask of me, and yet I am still sitting.
I delay and call my delay rest. Have mercy on me.
Let me walk in the way of Your commandments, one step at a time.
I will get up now and do the duty I have been avoiding. Amen.

prayers.title: Jesus, Keep Watch Over My Mind
prayers.full_text:
Christ, my Living God, You keep the world. Keep watch over my mind.
It goes back to the same sad field and stays until I cannot see a way out.
Do not let the thought that says there is no way out take charge.
In Your kindness, lift my head. Let me see Your rescue.
I will name one mercy You have already given, and ask for the help I need today.
Amen.

prayers.title: Bishop Andrewes - As Day Has Its Evening
prayers.full_text:
The day is gone,
and I give Thee thanks, O LORD.
Evening is at hand,
furnish it with brightness.
As day has its evening
so also has life;
the even of life is age,
age has overtaken me,
furnish it with brightness.
Cast me not away in the time of age;
forsake me not when my strength faileth me.
Even to my old age be Thou HE,
and even to hoar hairs carry me;
do Thou make, do Thou bear,
do Thou carry and deliver me.
Abide with me, LORD,
for it is toward evening,
and the day is far spent
of this fretful life.
Let Thy strength be made perfect
in my weakness.

Have mercy on Your creatures,
and on me, a grievous sinner.

prayers.title: Ambrose - Call Me Out of the Tomb
prayers.full_text:
Lord Jesus, I wish You would come
to this tomb of mine
and wash me with Your tears,
because my eyes have gone too hard
to cry enough to wash away what I have done.

If You weep for me, I will be saved.
If I am worth Your tears,
I will be clean of the stench of every wrong I have done.
If I am worth even a few of Your tears,
You will call me out of the tomb of this body
and say, "Come out,"
so that my thoughts are not shut up
inside the narrow walls of this body,
but go out to Christ,
and walk in the light,
thinking no more about the works of darkness,
but about the works of light.

Anyone who keeps dwelling on sins
locks themselves up
inside their own head.

So call Your servant out.
I am bound with the chain of my sins,
my feet fastened and my hands tied,
buried in dead thoughts and dead works,
but when You call,
I will walk out free.
prayers.modern:
Lord Jesus, I wish You would come
to this tomb of mine
and wash me with Your tears,
because my eyes have gone too hard
to cry enough to wash away what I have done.

If You weep for me, I will be saved.
If I am worth Your tears,
I will be clean of the stench of every wrong I have done.
If I am worth even a few of Your tears,
You will call me out of the tomb of this body
and say, "Come out,"
so that my thoughts are not shut up
inside the narrow walls of this body,
but go out to Christ,
and walk in the light,
thinking no more about the works of darkness,
but about the works of light.

Anyone who keeps dwelling on sins
locks themselves up
inside their own head.

So call Your servant out.
I am bound with the chain of my sins,
my feet fastened and my hands tied,
buried in dead thoughts and dead works,
but when You call,
I will walk out free.
prayers.original:
Would that Thou wouldst vouchsafe to come
to this sepulchre of mine, O Lord Jesus,
that Thou wouldst wash me with Thy tears;
since in my hardened eyes
I possess not such tears
as to be able to wash away my offence.

If Thou shalt weep for me I shall be saved;
if I am worthy of Thy tears
I shall cleanse the stench of all my offences;
if I am worthy that Thou weep but a little,
Thou wilt call me out of the tomb of this body
and will say: "Come forth,"
that my meditations may not be kept pent up
in the narrow limits of this body,
but may go forth to Christ,
and move in the light,
that I may think no more on works of darkness
but on works of light.

For he who thinks on sins
endeavours to shut himself up
within his own consciousness.

Call forth, then, Thy servant.
Although bound with the chain of my sins
I have my feet fastened and my hands tied;
being now buried in dead thoughts and works,
yet at Thy call
I shall go forth free.

prayers.title: Thomas à Kempis - For Those I Hurt, and Those Who Hurt Me
prayers.full_text:
I offer You my prayers, and the intercession of this sacrament,
especially for those who have hurt me in any way,
made me sad, spoken evil of me,
or caused me any loss or trouble;
and also for all those whom I have at any time made sad,
upset, burdened, or led astray,
by words or deeds, knowingly or unknowingly;
so that You may forgive all of us alike
our sins and the wrongs we have done each other.
Take away from our hearts, Lord,
all suspicion, resentment, anger, and quarreling,
and whatever can wound love and weaken our care for one another.
Have mercy, have mercy, Lord, on those who ask for Your mercy;
give grace to those in need;
and make us worthy to enjoy Your grace
and go on to eternal life. Amen.

About this prayer: It comes from The Imitation of Christ (Book IV, chapter 9), written by Thomas à Kempis in the 1420s for the moment of Holy Communion. In that chapter he offers to God, one by one, himself, his sins, what little good he has, and prayers for everyone he loves — and then, last of all, this: prayers for the people who hurt him, and for the people he hurt. The "also" in the older version is the final link of that chain. The first version is a modern English rendering made for this collection; the second is William Benham's translation of 1874, given word for word.

prayers.title: First Be Reconciled
prayers.full_text:
In vain with angry hearts we dare,
Lord, near Your altar move,
since neither sacrifice nor prayer
atones for lack of love.
So may we each with each agree
through Your uniting grace;
our gift will then accepted be,
our life of love and praise.

prayers.title: If Thou Sayest, Behold, We Knew It Not (Sonnet 1)
prayers.full_text:
I have done I know not what,—what have I done?
My brother's blood, my brother's soul, doth cry:
And I find no defence, find no reply,
No courage more to run this race I run
Not knowing what I have done, have left undone;
Ah me, these awful unknown hours that fly
Fruitless it may be, fleeting fruitless by
Rank with death-savor underneath the sun.
For what avails it that I did not know
The deed I did? what profits me the plea
That had I known I had not wronged him so?
Lord Jesus Christ, my God, him pity Thou;
Lord, if it may be, pity also me:
In judgment pity, and in death, and now.

prayers.footnote:
About this prayer: A sonnet by Christina Rossetti (1830–1894) on Proverbs 24:11–12 — "If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not," and the warning that God, who weighs hearts, knows. It is the older poem behind "The Rest of the List": the wrongs we did without seeing them, and what to do once we cannot un-know. Her answer ends where every honest amends-prayer ends, asking mercy for the one wronged first, and then for herself — "In judgment pity, and in death, and now." Her words are given unchanged.

cf. Proverbs 24:11–12

prayers.title: I Wake Up in Your Care
prayers.full_text: Lord God, heavenly Father, I wake up in Your care. Grant that I may spend this day without sin, and give myself with a cheerful heart to the work You've given me. Keep me from all harm today, and let Your Holy Spirit govern my steps, so that all of it may be for Your glory. Amen.
prayers.modern: Lord God, heavenly Father, I wake up in Your care. Grant that I may spend this day without sin, and give myself with a cheerful heart to the work You've given me. Keep me from all harm today, and let Your Holy Spirit govern my steps, so that all of it may be for Your glory. Amen.
prayers.original:
Lord, it's another plain day,
and most of it is the same work as yesterday.
Let me do it gladly, not grudgingly.
You gave me this work; help me do it right.
Keep me honest while I work.
Go ahead of me where I'm headed,
and where I'd step wrong, turn my feet.
Guard me from the harm I can't see coming.
And at the end of the day, let it count for something.
Amen.

Amen.

prayers.title: The Work You Have Called Me To
prayers.full_text: Lord God, my Maker and Redeemer, I give myself to You this morning, body and soul. Stir me up by Your Holy Spirit, so that I do not spend this day in sloth or sin, but do the work You have called me to, and do it well. Guide my feet, and prosper the work of my hands. Through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.modern: Lord God, my Maker and Redeemer, I give myself to You this morning, body and soul. Stir me up by Your Holy Spirit, so that I do not spend this day in sloth or sin, but do the work You have called me to, and do it well. Guide my feet, and prosper the work of my hands. Through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
prayers.original:
Lord, I don't feel like getting up today.
Get me up anyway.
I'm Yours this morning, tired as I am.
Don't let me waste the day on the couch,

Give me one job I can finish, and the strength to finish it.
Bless what I do with my hands today, even the small stuff.
Amen.

prayers.title: Through to Morning
prayers.full_text:
Lord God, heaven and earth are full of Your glory.
Thank You for bringing me safely through to morning.
As I begin this day, let Your will lead my way.
Strengthen me against every temptation.
Make me willing to do the work in front of me.
Amen.

prayers.original: Most holy and eternal God, Lord and sovereign of all creatures, I humbly present to Your divine Majesty myself, my soul and body, my thoughts and my words, my actions and intentions, my passions and my sufferings, to be disposed by You to Your glory; to be blessed by Your providence; to be guided by Your counsel; to be sanctified by Your Spirit; and afterwards, that my body and soul may be received into glory: for nothing can perish which is under Your custody, and the enemy of souls cannot devour what is Your portion, nor take it out of Your hands. This day, O Lord, and all the days of my life, I dedicate to Your honor, and the actions of my calling to the uses of grace, and the religion of all my days to be united to the merits and intercession of my holy Savior, Jesus; that in Him, and for Him, I may be pardoned and accepted. Amen.

prayers.title: Teach Me to Number My Days
prayers.full_text: My most glorious and gracious God, thank You for Your mercy through the night. Teach me to number my days and use my time well. Keep me from sloth and from giving my heart to empty things. Give me grace to live in reverence and fear of You, and to do faithfully whatever today asks of me. Rouse my sluggish spirit and bless my work. Amen.

Rouse my sluggish spirit and bless my work. Amen.
prayers.original: Most glorious God, maintain me in the life which You have given me here, until the work of life is finished. Give me such health of mind and body, and such protection and supply of all my needs, as shall best fit me for my duty. Make me content with my daily bread, and patient if I go without. Save me from the love of the riches, and honors, and pleasures of this world, and the pride, and idleness, and sensuality which they cherish. Cause me to serve Your providence by my diligent labors, and to serve You faithfully with all that You give me. And let me not make provision for the flesh, to satisfy its desires and lusts. Amen.

prayers.title: Under the Shadow of Your Wing
prayers.full_text:
Awake, my soul, and with the sun
your daily stage of duty run;
shake off dull sloth, and joyful rise
to pay your morning sacrifice.

Lord, those black mists have closed around me again: dread, gloom, the sense that something is wrong. Clear them away. Hide me under the shadow of Your wing. Where else can I go? Evil thoughts and suspicious fears are spreading through me. Stop them. My heart keeps running ahead to troubles that may never come. Hold it still. Let me lean my whole weight on You until I am quiet. Through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Bring My Thoughts into Obedience
prayers.full_text: God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, Father of mercies and God of all comfort, look on me with compassion. Let the light of Your face shine upon me and scatter every cloud of darkness, despair, and restless dread from my soul. Govern my unruly imagination and bring every thought into obedience to Christ. Let neither the worries of life nor the vain thoughts of my own heart lead me astray. Give me a quiet mind, a peaceful conscience, and a firm resolve to do Your will. For the sake of Jesus Christ. Amen.

prayers.title: Glad to Do My Part
prayers.full_text:
Lord, You call me to my work again, and I am glad to do my part.
I take up my daily task with my eyes on You and a faithful heart.
All things are possible to one who trusts Your word and seeks Your face;
and it is You who give me strength to rise, to act, to run the race.
Stay close beside me all day long, and bless whatever work I do.
Amen.

prayers.original:
Forth in Your name, O Lord, I go,
my daily labour to pursue;
You, only You, resolved to know
in all I think, or speak, or do.

The task Your wisdom has assigned
O let me cheerfully fulfil;
in all my works Your presence find,
and prove Your acceptable will.

Preserve me from my calling's snare,
and hide my simple heart above,
above the thorns of choking care,
the gilded baits of worldly love.

May I set You at my right hand,
whose eyes my inmost substance view,
and labour on at Your command,
and offer all my works to You.

Give me to bear Your easy yoke,
and every moment watch and pray,
and still to things eternal look,
and hasten to Your glorious day.

For You delightfully employ
whate'er Your bounteous grace has given,
and run my course with even joy,
and closely walk with You to heaven.
Amen.

prayers.title: With a Single Heart
prayers.full_text:
Called back to work, I start anew,
still glad to do my part;
Lord, in Your name my task I do,
and with a single heart.

You are the end of all I do —
I see You everywhere!
Accept the work I bring to You,
my labor made a prayer.

All that the Father sees as Yours
He sees with gracious eyes;
Lord Jesus, join my offering
to Your great sacrifice.

Stamped with Your worth that never ends,
my work the Father owns —
well pleased with me, His beloved child,
for I am Yours alone!
Amen.

prayers.original:
Summon'd my labour to renew,
And glad to act my part,
Lord, in Thy name my task I do,
And with a single heart.

End of my every action Thou!
Thyself in all I see:
Accept my hallow'd labour now;
I do it unto Thee.

Whate'er the Father views as Thine,
He views with gracious eyes.
Jesus! this mean oblation join
To Thy great sacrifice.

Stamp'd with an infinite desert,
My work He then shall own;
Well-pleased in me, when mine Thou art,
And I His favourite son!

prayers.title: Morning Prayer for Clarity and Direction
prayers.full_text:
Heavenly Father,
Put Your desires in my heart.
Help me think clearly, see truthfully, and do what pleases You.
Put my thoughts, life, and schedule in proper order for Your glory.
Lord, make it clear to me what You want today,
and give me the guidance and strength to do it well.

Keep me steady, Lord.
Not shaken by hard times, and not inflated by good ones.
Let me be moved only by what draws me to You
or warns me I'm drifting away from You. Amen.
