prayers.title: Let Me Desire What Pleases You
prayers.full_text:
Grant me, merciful God, the desire to eagerly do what pleases You,
to examine wisely, to acknowledge truthfully, and to accomplish perfectly,
for the praise and glory of Your name.

Order my life, Lord God! Show me what You want me to do.
Help me do it as I should, in a way that is fitting and good for my soul.

Don't let me get proud in good times, nor disheartened in bad ones.
Let me rejoice only in doing Your will, and grieve only over what separates me from You. Amen.

prayers.full_text:
Gracious God, quiet my circling mind.
I keep replaying the same thoughts and getting nowhere.
Bring my thinking back into the present,
put my day before me in clear, simple order.
Show me the next right thing You have for me,
and settle me enough, Lord, to do it. Amen.

prayers.title: I Don't Need to See Everything
prayers.full_text:
Father, put my life in order to honor You.
My mind wants to run ahead and around in circles.
Make the path plain.
I don't need to see everything, God.
Just show me what is mine to do and give me grace to do it.
With Your help, God, I will do the work You've set before me.
The rest is up to You. Amen.

prayers.title: Steady Hands and a Steady Heart
prayers.full_text:
Lord, give me steady hands and a steady heart.
Don't let me unravel when times get hard.
Don't let me get distracted when times are good.
Don't let my highs and lows decide the day.
Let me draw closer to You, God.
Keep me level, keep me close, and
keep me busy at what You have given me.
Amen.

prayers.title: Open My Mouth to Bless Your Name
prayers.full_text:
Lord, open my mouth to bless Your holy name.
Cleanse my heart of all vain, evil, and wandering thoughts.
Enlighten my mind and set my heart on fire with love for You.
Let me pray this worthily, attentively, and devoutly,
and be heard in the presence of Your divine majesty.
Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

Move my hands to do Your will.
Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: You Alone Are Enough
prayers.full_text:
Lord, don't let anything disturb or frighten me tonight.
While everything else changes, You are eternal.
Give me the patience to bear my burdens.
You are all I need - You alone are enough.
Give me the guidance to do the next right thing.
I pray this through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: I Surrender My Worries to You
prayers.full_text:
Lord, take everything that makes me who I am:
my freedom, my memory, my intellect, and my will.
You have given all of it to me, Lord; I return it now.
All is Yours. Do with it what You will.
Give me only Your love and Your steady presence.
That is more than enough for me.
Take my worries too,
as I walk the path You have set before me.
Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

All is Yours. Do with it what You will.
Give me only Your love and Your steady presence.
That is more than enough for me.
Take my worries too,
as I walk the path You have set before me.
Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

All is thine, dispose of it wholly according to thy will. Give me thy love and thy grace, for this is sufficient for me. Amen.

prayers.title: I Will Not Fear Tomorrow
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I will not fear what may happen tomorrow.
You are the same eternal Father who cares for me today,
and You will care for me tomorrow and every day of my life.
Either You will keep me from suffering,
or You will give me strength and faith to bear it.
So I will be at peace, and I will put away all anxious thoughts,
and cast every fearful possibility from my heart.
I will walk in Your ways today and all my days.
In Jesus' name, I pray, Amen.

prayers.title: Kicking the Panic Loop to the Curb
prayers.full_text:
Lord, I'm going to stop stressing over what might go wrong tomorrow.
You're the same God who has my back tonight,
and You're going to take care of me tomorrow and every single day after that.
Lord, I know You'll either keep the trouble away from me,
or You'll give me the guts and resilience to handle it.
I'm going to settle down inside now, relax,
and kick every anxious thought and panic loop straight out of my head.
Thank You, Jesus Christ. Amen.

prayers.full_text:
God, today I'm giving You all my thoughts, words and actions.
Take away the needless worries troubling me.
With Your divine guidance, order all that happens to me today.
Let my mind rest and my heart be at ease in Your will.
I trust You to turn all that happens to Your glory and my good.
Guide me now to the next right step on Your path.
Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Be My Strong Shield for Today
prayers.full_text: Almighty God, thank You for waking me up and getting me safely to the start of this day. Put Your strong shield around me right now. Don't let me slip into bad habits, mess up, or walk into unnecessary trouble today. Take the steering wheel of my mind so my thoughts aren't spinning out in fear, but are focused on doing what's right and useful, through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

Shine on me today. Wake me up from sleep, and help me live pure.
Guide me now to do what's right, turning my heart completely to You, Lord.
Amen.

prayers.title: Until My Work Is Done
prayers.full_text:
Lord, stay with me all day long in this hard life, until the shadows get long and evening comes, the busy world goes quiet, the fever of life breaks, and my work is done.
Then in Your mercy give me a safe place to stay, holy rest, and peace at the end.
Through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: From Morning Till Night
prayers.full_text:
Christ, I trust in You and bow before You.
You are maker of the morning light and the whole world.
Point my feet directly toward good work today.
Give me the strength to live out Your will from morning till night.
Amen.
prayers.modern:

Amen.
prayers.original: I confess with faith, and adore thee, o Light indivisible, simultaneous, holy Trinity, and one Godhead: Creator of light and dispeller of darkness, dispel from my soul the darkness of sin and ignorance, and at this hour enlighten my mind, that I may pray to thee according to thy will, and receive from thee what I petition for. Have mercy on me a grievous sinner.

prayers.title: Let Your Mercy Be the Greater Thing
prayers.full_text:
Almighty God, Lord of heaven and earth,
I come to You ashamed and in fear.
I sinned repeatedly today, and I won't dress it up.
I have sinned against You in thought, word, and deed.
Your word is holy. Your judgments are to be feared.
I have broken Your law.
Where would I be if You dealt the punishment I deserve?

But You are not only my judge.
You are my Redeemer, my Christ.
I have sinned, and Jesus, You are my advocate.
Don't judge me, or I am lost. Save me, Lord.
Spare the one You redeemed with Your blood.
Do not store up my sins for a day of reckoning.
Let Your mercy be the greater thing.
Free me from the power of sin, and keep me from its punishment. Amen.
prayers.modern:

But You are not only my judge.

I have sinned, and Jesus, You are my advocate.

Spare the one You redeemed with Your blood.
Do not store up my sins for a day of reckoning.
Let Your mercy be the greater thing.
Free me from the power of sin, and keep me from its punishment. Amen.
prayers.original:
O Almighty Lord of heaven and earth, I desire with fear and shame to cast myself down before thee, humbly confessing my manifold sins and unsufferable wickedness. I confess, O great God, that I have sinned grievously against thee by thought, word and deed (particularly this day). Thy words and thy laws, O God, are holy, and thy judgments are terrible! But I have broken all thy righteous laws, and incurred thy severest judgments; and where shall I appear when thou art angry?

But, O Lord my judge, thou art also my Redeemer! I have sinned, but thou, O blessed Jesus, art my Advocate! Enter not into judgment with me, lest I die; but spare me, gracious Lord, spare thy servant, whom thou hast redeemed with thy most precious blood. O reserve not evil in store for me against the day of vengeance, but let thy mercy be magnified upon me. Deliver me from the power of sin, and preserve me from the punishment of it.

prayers.title: Nothing That Does Not End in You
prayers.full_text:
Lord, everything was made for Your pleasure, and yet You did not please Yourself.
Give me a share of Your Spirit, so that I can follow You in that.
Make me self-controlled in everything.
Let me use what You made only for what You made it for,
and never more of it than that needs.
Help me turn down pleasures that do not prepare me for You;
those pleasures fight my soul and pull me away from You.
Let me want nothing that does not end in You. Amen.
prayers.modern:

Give me a share of Your Spirit, so that I can follow You in that.
Make me self-controlled in everything.

and never more of it than that needs.
Help me turn down pleasures that do not prepare me for You;

Let me want nothing that does not end in You. Amen.
prayers.original: O thou, who didst not please thyself, although for thy pleasure all things are and were created, let some portion of thy Spirit descend on me, that I may deny myself and follow thee. Strengthen my soul that I may be temperate in all things; that I may never use any of thy creatures, but in order to some end thou commandest me to pursue, and in that measure and manner which most conduces to it. Let me never gratify any desire which has not thee for its ultimate object. Let me ever abstain from all pleasures which do not prepare me for taking pleasure in thee, as knowing that all such war against the soul, and tend to alienate it from thee. Amen.

prayers.title: My Enemies First
prayers.full_text:
Gracious Lord, look kindly on all my enemies, and on everyone who is suffering.
Give them patience in what they are going through.
Let them find rest in Your kingdom, where no one troubles them anymore.
Lord, be merciful to them on the day of judgment.
Give that same mercy and peace to Your whole Church.

I bring You my father and mother, my brothers and sisters, my friends, and my relatives.
You know what each of them needs better than I do. Fit Your blessing to each one.

Let these prayers reach Your throne through Jesus Christ, Your beloved Son, the righteous one.
To Him, and to You, Father, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, be all love and obedience, now and forever. Amen.
prayers.modern:

prayers.original:
With a propitious eye, O gracious Lord, behold all my enemies, and all that are in affliction; give them patience under their sufferings, and grant that they, and all the members of thy Church, may find rest, where the wicked cease from troubling, and mercy in the great day of trial. In particular I commend to thy mercy my father and mother, my brethren and sisters, my friends and relations. Lord, thou best knowest all their wants: O suit thy blessings to their several necessities.

Let these my prayers, O Lord, find access to the throne of grace, through the Son of thy love, Jesus Christ the righteous: to whom, with thee, O Father, in the unity of the Spirit, be all love and obedience now and for ever!

prayers.title: Nothing Left Out
prayers.full_text:
Lord Jesus Christ, You praised God with Your whole heart on earth.
You praise Him still in the Eucharist.
You will praise Him until the world ends.
Today I join Your praise of the Father.
I offer You everything, nothing left out:
my intentions and my thoughts,
what I say, feel, want, and do.
Form it to the Immaculate Heart of Mary, Your mother.
Amen.

prayers.original: Lord Jesus Christ, in union with that divine intention with which Thou didst on earth offer praises to God through thy Sacred Heart, and now dost continue to offer them in all places in the Sacrament of the Eucharist, and wilt do so to the end of the world, I most willingly offer Thee, throughout this entire day without the smallest exception, all my intentions and thoughts, all my affections and desires, all my words and actions, that they may be conformed to the most sacred heart of the blessed Virgin Mary ever Immaculate.

prayers.title: Light the Darkness of My Mind
prayers.full_text:
Great and glorious God, my Lord Jesus Christ,
light the darkness of my mind.
Give me a right faith, a sure hope, and a perfect love.
Let me know You, Lord, so that in all things
I do Your holy and true will.
Amen.

prayers.title: O Lord, Open Thou My Mouth (Aperi, Domine)
prayers.full_text: O Lord, open Thou my mouth that I may bless Thy Holy Name; cleanse my heart from all vain, evil, and wandering thoughts; enlighten my understanding; kindle my affections, that I may worthily, attentively, and devoutly pray … and may deserve to be heard before the presence of Thy divine Majesty. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

prayers.title: Do Not Look Forward to What May Happen To-morrow
prayers.full_text: Do not look forward to what may happen to-morrow; the same Everlasting Father Who cares for you to-day, will take care of you to-morrow, and every day. Either He will shield you from suffering, or He will give you unfailing strength to bear it. Be at peace, then; put aside all anxious thoughts and imaginations.
